pages.en:
August 16, 1939. Morning Translation.

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper)
publishes the following comment :-

"THE AUTHORITIES OF THE FOREIGN SETTLEMENTS OF SHANGHAI
SHOULD AT ONCE CHECK THE RISE IN PRICES OF COMMODITIES"

The drop in the value of the dollar has
caused a sharp rise in the prices of commodities and has
seriously affected the livelihood of the inhabitants of
Shanghai. The Kuomintang Government should be held
responsible for this state of affairs.
The anti-Japanese newspapers are unwilling
to speak of punishing the traitorous merchants but are
instead exhorting the people to endure hardship and have
confidence in the legal tender notes.
According to reliable reports, the ricsha
trade, lawyers, accountants, teachers, doctors and
various fellow countrymen associations in Shanghai have
sent petitions to the authorities of the Foreign
Settlements and the Chamber of Commerce requesting them
to devise measures to check the increase in prices, to
make discreet investigations, and to adjust prices.
All these demands are very reasonable.
Nevertheless, the authorities of the
Foreign Settlements are to blame. The Chamber of
Commerce and other responsible organs should endeavour
to check the arbitrary increase of prices. The
inhabitants are now collectively requesting the authorities
to do this.
To check the rise in the prices of
commodities is the urgent task at present.
Rice and fuel are daily necessities.
Provided the price of rice and coal can be stabilized
there need be no worry about supplies. It will not
matter much if dance tickets should be sold at $10 each
and ice cream at $5 a cup. We even approve that prices
of cosmetics should be increased to a price dearer than
that of diamonds or platinum. All this indicates that
the authorities should lower the prices of daily
necessities but increase the prices of unnecessary
things.
Checking the rise in the prices of commodities
will be beneficial to the Foreign Settlements, otherwise
loafers and robbers will run wild. For the sake of
peace and order in the districts, the Foreign Settlements
should put a stop to the increasing of prices. If the
authorities hesitate or delay to take action, peace and
order in Shanghai will be endangered, while those who
depend upon their paltry wages will be driven to
desperation.
It is hoped that the authorities of the
Foreign Settlements and the Chamber of Commerce will
do something to save the life of millions of citizens.
pages.zh:
1939年8月16日。晨间译文。

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）发表如下评论：

“上海外国租界当局应立即制止物价上涨”

美元贬值导致商品价格急剧上涨，严重影响了上海居民的生计。国民党政府应对此局面负责。
反日报纸不愿谈论惩罚奸商，反而劝告人民忍受苦难，并对法币保持信心。
据可靠消息，上海的黄包车行业、律师、会计师、教师、医生以及各类同乡会已向外国租界当局和商会递交请愿书，要求他们制定措施以遏制价格上涨，进行审慎调查，并调整价格。
所有这些要求都非常合理。
然而，外国租界当局难辞其咎。商会和其他责任机构应努力遏制任意涨价的行为。居民们现在集体要求当局这样做。
遏制商品价格上涨是当前的紧迫任务。
大米和燃料是日常必需品。只要米价和煤价能够稳定，供应就无需担忧。舞票卖到每张10元，冰淇淋卖到每杯5元，都无伤大雅。我们甚至赞成化妆品的价格涨得比钻石或白金还贵。这一切表明，当局应该降低日常必需品的价格，而提高非必需品的价格。
遏制商品价格上涨将有利于外国租界，否则游手好闲之徒和强盗将会横行。为了各区的和平与秩序，外国租界应制止涨价。如果当局犹豫或拖延采取行动，上海的和平与秩序将受到威胁，而那些依靠微薄工资生活的人将被逼入绝境。
希望外国租界当局和商会能采取一些措施来拯救数百万市民的生命。

pages.en:
August 13, 1939.
Morning Translation.

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper):
MAYOR FU DESIRES RETURN OF LOCAL COURTS

Recently Mayor Fu Siao-en of the Shanghai
City Government wrote to the Senior Consul of the Consular
Body, the Chairman of the S.M.C. and the French Consul-
General in Shanghai demanding the immediate return of the
First and the Second Special District Courts to the City
Government, but so far no definite replies have been
received.

The Mayor on August 12 sent the following
letter to the Consular Body, the S.M.C. and the French
Consulate-Generals:-
"The Shanghai First Special District Court
which is a judicial organ of the Chungking Government
enforces the law and ordinances promulgated by the Chungking
Government whose absurd and improper judgments have become
notorious.
"With a view to maintaining peace and order
in the district and to put a complete check on the
activities of the Kuomintang bandits, the Shanghai City
Government on February 10, March 10 and 29 and May 16
wrote to the Consular Body and the S.M.C. requesting that
their assistance in securing the return of the Shanghai
First Special District Court be rendered. We regret
to record that no replies have been forthcoming. You
are requested to make clear your attitude towards the
request of the City Government.
"In an area under the control of the new
regime, such judicial organs should never have been
permitted to function; in other words, as the Courts lie
in the area within the control of the City Government, they
should be immediately taken over by the City Government.
You are requested to respect the judicial rights of the
new regime so as to avoid trouble and to facilitate
co-operation. An early reply is expected."
pages.zh:
1939年8月13日。
晨间译文。

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）：
傅市长希望收回地方法院

近日，上海市政府市长傅筱庵致函领事团首席领事、工部局总董及法国驻上海总领事，要求立即将第一和第二特区法院交还给市政府，但迄今未收到明确答复。

市长于8月12日向领事团、工部局和法国总领事馆发出如下信函：
“上海第一特区法院是重庆政府的司法机关，执行重庆政府颁布的法律和条例，其荒谬且不当的判决已臭名昭著。
“为了维护辖区内的和平与秩序，并彻底遏制国民党匪徒的活动，上海市政府曾于2月10日、3月10日和29日以及5月16日致函领事团和工部局，请求协助收回上海第一特区法院。遗憾的是，未获回复。请贵方阐明对市政府请求的态度。
“在新政权控制的区域内，此类司法机关本不应被允许运作；换言之，既然这些法院位于市政府控制的区域内，它们应立即由市政府接管。请尊重新政权的司法权利，以避免麻烦并促进合作。期待早日回复。”

pages.en:
July 21, 1939. Afternoon Translation.

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper)
publishes the following editorial: -

THE ANTI-BRITISH MOVEMENT AND THE DIPLOMACY OF
THE NEW REGIME

New China is co-operating with Japan along
the path of stability. The diplomatic activities of the
new regime are of great importance. The stability of
the regime will depend upon the efforts to get rid of
the dangerous factors surrounding it.
Japan is endeavouring to annihilate the
Kuomintang Government by armed force, but it is also her
duty to stabilize the position of the new regime. To
get rid of the dangerous factors, it is necessary to
improve the diplomatic relations between the new regime
and foreign countries. Thus, the work of the foreign
affairs department of the "Reformed Government" is of
great importance.
Facts show that the anti-British movement
in China was promoted by the Chinese people. We have
not heard of any action taken by the "Reformed Government"
in the anti-British movement.
Ever since the assassination of the Foreign
Minister of the "Reformed Government", the diplomatic
authorities have failed to make a reorganization; it
seems to us that the authorities are sleeping. With a
view to assisting China to secure her independence and
the emancipation of her people, Japan has opened
negotiations with Britain and this has given rise to
the so-called Settlement question which is one affecting
China. Why are the diplomatic authorities of the
"Reformed Government" inactive? Co-operation of our
friendly nation is being secured. The new Chinese
Government should exert its utmost to cope with the
situation.
On the basis of permanent Sino-Japanese
co-operation and the construction of a new order in East
Asia, Japan should direct the new Chinese Government to
improve its administration and to undertake military
operations to remove the influence of the Kuomintang
Government. The Japanese military authorities are
fighting for New China at heavy sacrifices; they should
also devise ways and means to strengthen the new Chinese
Government and detail experts in diplomatic affairs to
help her.
The people of New China are advancing together
with the Japanese flag and are prepared to struggle at all
cost against Britain. We hope that the "Reformed
Government" will lead the people in dealing with the
situation.
The anti-British movement is really a movement
for the emancipation and revival of China and China's
political policy should be in accordance with this aim.
The emancipation and revival of China will be undertaken
by the diplomatic authorities and the new government
should order a thorough reform of its diplomacy so that
negotiations for the recovery of the Courts in the Foreign
Settlements may be initiated.
pages.zh:
1939年7月21日。午后译文。

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）发表如下社论：

反英运动与新政权的外交

新中国正沿着稳定的道路与日本合作。新政权的外交活动至关重要。政权的稳定将取决于消除周围危险因素的努力。
日本正致力于通过武力消灭国民党政府，但稳定新政权的地位也是其职责。为了消除危险因素，必须改善新政权与外国之间的外交关系。因此，“维新政府”外交部的工作至关重要。
事实表明，中国的反英运动是由中国人民推动的。我们未曾听说“维新政府”在反英运动中采取过任何行动。
自从“维新政府”外交部长遇刺以来，外交当局未能进行重组；在我们看来，当局似乎正在沉睡。为了协助中国获得独立和人民解放，日本已与英国展开谈判，由此产生了所谓的租界问题，这是一个影响中国的问题。为什么“维新政府”的外交当局无所作为？友好国家的合作正在达成。新中国政府应竭尽全力应对局势。
基于永久性的中日合作和东亚新秩序的建设，日本应指导新中国政府改善行政管理，并进行军事行动以消除国民党政府的影响。日本军方正在为新中国付出巨大牺牲而战；他们还应设法加强新中国政府，并派遣外交事务专家予以协助。
新中国的人民正与日本国旗一同前进，准备不惜一切代价与英国斗争。我们希望“维新政府”能领导人民应对局势。
反英运动实际上是一场旨在解放和复兴中国的运动，中国的政治政策应符合这一目标。中国的解放和复兴将由外交当局承担，新政府应命令对其外交进行彻底改革，以便启动关于收回外国租界内法院的谈判。

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper)
publishes the following comment :-

"THE FATE OF THE BRITISH CONCESSIONS IN CHINA"

Great Britain has, in all, six Concessions in
China; they are to be found in Shanghai, Tientsin, Canton,
Hankow, Kowloon and Kulangsu. As the British Concession
at Hankow was recovered by China in 1927 and those
at Shanghai and Kulangsu are of an international nature,
she has actually only two Concessions: one at Tientsin and
one at Canton that are purely under her control.
pages.zh:
《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）发表如下评论：

“英国在华租界的命运”

英国在中国共有六个租界；分别位于上海、天津、广州、汉口、九龙和鼓浪屿。由于汉口的英国租界已于1927年被中国收回，而上海和鼓浪屿的租界具有国际性质，实际上她只有两个完全由其控制的租界：一个在天津，一个在广州。

pages.en:
June 19, 1939.
Morning Translation

On June 14 the British Concession at Tientsin was blockaded by Japanese forces and there is even a tendency of its being seized altogether by the new Chinese Government.

As the British Concessions in China were created by means of armed oppression, their existence has no legal basis. Instead of adopting an attitude of friendship and co-operation for the promotion of commerce to the mutual benefit of China and Britain, the latter, relying on her special position created by the treaties, has been making use of the Concessions as bases for economic and political aggression in China, thereby destroying China's trade and industry and dominating China's political affairs. Moreover, Britain is harbouring a large number of unlawful elements to undermine China's reconstruction. On this account, the British Concessions in China are regarded by the Chinese people as places of evil.

Following the outbreak of the present Sino-Japanese hostilities, the British, utilizing the neutral status of the Concessions, are supporting the Kuomintang regime for the sole purpose of prolonging the hostilities and obstructing peace in East Asia. Such action is condemned by international law and is being bitterly deplored by Far Eastern peoples. This is one of the main reasons why the British Concessions should be immediately abolished.

At this time when order in East Asia is about to be assured and the Kuomintang regime is on the verge of collapse, the British, in utter ignorance of the determination of the Japanese army to establish order in East Asia, are tolerating the acts of terrorism and speeches of Kuomintang agents in the Concessions; they even secretly supply money and munitions to guerrillas to enable them to disturb peace and order. Such acts have occurred time and again, and despite the advice of the Japanese authorities, the British are continuing to maintain an insincere attitude. Take, for instance, the case of the prejudiced support rendered by the British to the four suspects arrested in connection with the assassination of Zung Sih-keng in Tientsin; these men should have been handed over to the Japanese authorities as the latter have definitely proved them to be the culprits. Therefore, the action taken by the Japanese forces on June 14 in blockading the British Concession is proper. Why? Because only strong action can arouse the British to a proper understanding of the situation. If the British repent their mistakes and thoroughly rectify their policy of rendering assistance to Chiang Kai-shek and co-operate whole-heartedly with Japan and the new Chinese Government, the question of British Concessions may be settled amicably. However, judging by the reaction created on British public opinion over the Tientsin barricade, we realize that there is very little hope of this theory bearing fruit.

A section of British public opinion has even suggested the application of economic sanctions against Japan. This is indeed foolish and unreasonable talk, but it shows that Britain is yet far from a proper understanding of the situation. We hope that the Japanese soldiers, supported by the enthusiastic hopes of the Chinese people, will unhesitatingly adopt more resolute measures, thereby strengthening the foundations of a peaceful order in East Asia.
pages.zh:
1939年6月19日。
晨间译文

6月14日，天津英国租界被日军封锁，甚至出现被新中国政府完全接管的趋势。

由于在华英国租界是通过武装压迫建立的，其存在没有法律依据。后者没有采取友好合作的态度以促进中英互惠的商业发展，而是依靠条约赋予的特殊地位，利用租界作为对华经济和政治侵略的基地，从而破坏中国的贸易和工业，并支配中国的政治事务。此外，英国还庇护大量不法分子以破坏中国的重建。因此，在华英国租界被中国人民视为邪恶之地。

随着当前中日敌对行动的爆发，英国利用租界的中立地位，支持国民党政权，其唯一目的是延长敌对状态并阻碍东亚和平。这种行为受到国际法的谴责，并遭到远东人民的强烈谴责。这是应立即废除英国租界的主要原因之一。

此时，东亚秩序即将确立，国民党政权濒临崩溃，英国完全无视日军建立东亚秩序的决心，容忍租界内国民党特工的恐怖行为和言论；他们甚至秘密向游击队提供资金和军火，使其扰乱和平与秩序。此类事件屡见不鲜，尽管日本当局提出建议，英国仍继续维持不真诚的态度。例如，英国偏袒地支持因天津宗社庆（音译）遇刺案被捕的四名嫌疑人；既然日本方面已确证这些人为罪犯，本应将他们移交给日本当局。因此，日军于6月14日封锁英国租界的行动是正当的。为什么？因为只有强有力的行动才能唤起英国对局势的正确认识。如果英国悔悟其错误，彻底纠正援助蒋介石的政策，并与日本和新中国政府全心合作，英国租界问题或许可以和平解决。然而，从英国公众舆论对天津封锁线的反应来看，我们意识到这一理论取得成果的希望渺茫。

部分英国公众舆论甚至建议对日本实施经济制裁。这确实是愚蠢且不合理的言论，但这表明英国远未正确理解局势。我们希望在日本士兵得到中国人民热情希望的支持下，毫不犹豫地采取更坚决的措施，从而加强东亚和平秩序的基础。

July 18, 1939. Afternoon Translation.

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper) :-

LOCAL HOUSE RENTS INCREASED

Owing to the high cost of living, rents of
offices and large buildings in this locality have been
increased. Foreigners are attempting to increase the rents
of their buildings by 20 or 30 per cent on the plea of the
sharp decline in the value of the dollar. Some intend to
change the house rent from dollars to gold dollars while
others have increased the house rents under the pretext of
the increased gas and water rates. However, many disputes
have arisen with the tenants.
Most large local buildings belong to Sassoon
and Hardoon and disputes over house rent cannot be avoided.

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）：-

本地房租上涨

由于生活成本高昂，本地办公室及大型建筑的租金已上涨。外国人以美元币值急剧下跌为由，试图将其楼宇租金提高20%或30%。有些人打算将房租由美元改为金元计收，另一些人则以煤气和水费上涨为借口提高房租。然而，这引发了与租户的许多纠纷。
本地大多数大型建筑属于沙逊（Sassoon）和哈同（Hardoon），因此房租纠纷不可避免。

July 14, 1939.
Afternoon Translation.

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper):-

THE SINO-JAPANESE HOSTILITIES AND FOREIGN AID

China and Japan are two large nations in East Asia and are of the same civilization and race. They are closely connected with each other.
The war between China and Japan has been going on since the Lukouchiao Incident and the people of China are suffering terribly. The majority of the Chinese people are expecting an early conclusion of the war, but Chiang Kai-shek and others, moved by assistance received from Soviet Russia, are prolonging the war by declaring that China will secure the final victory. As a matter of fact, the people are in a most distressful condition. Two-thirds of Chinese territory have been lost during the fighting for the past two years and the national strength is nearly exhausted. Unless the stubborn policy of the Chiang Kai-shek regime is changed, the situation of China will become so bad that no remedy will be found.
The Lukouchiao Incident was originally a local affair. Nevertheless, Chiang Kai-shek deliberately extended the affair and in addition, he created the Shanghai war on August 13, 1937. The war has thus spread and the people are in great distress. At this time when China is on the verge of ruin, Chiang Kai-shek should immediately change his policy and sue for peace. History tells us that a nation may carry on war should it be able to do so, otherwise it should sue for peace. Chiang Kai-shek, however, does not act like this; he is influenced by the sweet tune of Britain and the slight assistance from Soviet Russia. He desires to gain the final victory with assistance from foreign countries. To rely upon foreign strength to resist a strong enemy is as dangerous as leading a tiger to drive away a wolf.
Chiang Kai-shek wants to struggle for final victory by means of the influence of Britain and Soviet Russia. Are Britain and Soviet Russia sincere in assisting China? The foreign policy of Britain is well known for its cunning. We remember that when Italy was about to attack Abyssinia, Britain gave sweet words to the Emperor of Abyssinia, promised to give him assistance and urged him to make sacrifices and carry on a war of resistance. As a consequence, Britain only sent two warships to protect the Emperor of Abyssinia on his abdication. Of late, Britain sacrificed Czechoslovakia. In view of the above, can the sweet words and small loans of Britain enable China to carry on the war for a long time?
Now, it is clear that Britain cannot be relied upon. Soviet Russia is assisting China more than Britain, but we must realize that no nation in the world is willing to assist a foreign country without certain conditions. Therefore, there is a certain motive for Soviet Russia's assistance to China.
We have already said that to rely upon foreign influence to resist a strong enemy is a dangerous and stupid policy.

1939年7月14日。
下午译文。

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）：-

中日敌对行动与外国援助

中国和日本是东亚的两个大国，拥有相同的文明和种族。两国彼此联系紧密。
自卢沟桥事变以来，中日战争一直持续，中国人民遭受了巨大的苦难。大多数中国人期望战争早日结束，但蒋介石等人受苏联俄罗斯援助的鼓动，宣称中国将获得最终胜利，从而 prolonging（延长）战争。事实上，民众处于极度困苦的境地。在过去两年的战斗中，中国三分之二的领土已经丧失，国力几乎耗尽。除非改变蒋介石政权的顽固政策，否则中国的局势将恶化到无药可救的地步。
卢沟桥事变原本是一起局部事件。然而，蒋介石故意扩大事态，此外，他还于1937年8月13日制造了上海战争。战争由此蔓延，民众深受其苦。在中国濒临毁灭之际，蒋介石应立即改变政策，求和。历史告诉我们，一个国家若能战则战，否则应求和。然而，蒋介石并未如此行事；他受到英国的甜言蜜语和苏联俄罗斯的微薄援助的影响。他希望依靠外国的援助获得最终胜利。依靠外国力量来抵抗强敌，如同引虎驱狼般危险。
蒋介石想借助英国和苏联俄罗斯的影响力争取最终胜利。英国和苏联俄罗斯是否真心援助中国？英国的外交政策以狡诈著称。我们记得，当意大利即将攻击阿比西尼亚时，英国对阿比西尼亚皇帝说了许多甜言蜜语，承诺给予援助，并敦促他做出牺牲，进行抵抗战争。结果，英国仅在阿比西尼亚皇帝退位时派遣了两艘军舰予以保护。最近，英国牺牲了捷克斯洛伐克。鉴于上述情况，英国的甜言蜜语和小额贷款能使中国长期维持战争吗？
现在，显然英国不可依赖。苏联俄罗斯对中国的援助多于英国，但我们必须认识到，世界上没有任何国家愿意在没有任何条件的情况下援助外国。因此，苏联俄罗斯援助中国是有某种动机的。
我们已经说过，依靠外国影响力来抵抗强敌是一项危险且愚蠢的政策。

July 13, 1939.
Afternoon Translation.

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper)
publishes the following comment:

UNRULY ELEMENTS IN THE FOREIGN SETTLEMENTS AGAIN
ACTIVE

Taking advantage of the peculiar conditions
in the Foreign Settlements, the Chiang Kai-shek regime has
often directly or indirectly carried out illegal and
treacherous plots instigating assassination. Actually,
these activities have not only failed to produce any
effect upon the peace movement for national salvation but
they have on the contrary exposed the ugliness behind the
mask of the Kuomintang regime. They only hasten the
latter's suicide and collapse. All this is due to the
rigid surveillance and strict suppression on the part of
the Japanese authorities and the "Reformed Government"
during the past two years.
Politically, the unruly elements in the
Foreign Settlements seem to have been deprived of all means
for shelter as a result of continued extensive search by
the authorities and the repeated discovery of the
terroristic bodies of the Kuomintang Government. Culturally,
since the Shanghai District Kuomintang, the highest organ
in Shanghai of the Kuomintang Government, was unconditionally
dissolved as a result of reasonable measures adopted by
the authorities, the peace influence of the new government
has become gradually enhanced. For instance, all
educational institutions have changed their formerly
mistaken policy, while the newspapers, especially those
anti-Japanese ones under foreign registration, have
suspended publication one after another. Those which are
still publishing have likewise made radical changes in their
policy of subversive propaganda. Even in bookstores,
all books of a propaganda nature have been replaced by
those suitable to the present occasion. It is true that
the S.M.C. is partly responsible for the disappearance
of the anti-Japanese and anti-"Reformed Government"
atmosphere in this isolated island of Shanghai during the
past few months. However, we cannot remain complacent
when we see that the communist bandits under the control
of the Chiang Kai-shek Government have now resumed their
activities.
The following facts are worthy of attention:-
As soon as the unlawful elements in the
foreign controlled areas are not in a position to carry
out their beastly activities, they are regarded as disloyal
to their duty by the Kuomintang Government and are deprived
of their financial support, thereby being unable to
maintain their living. Some have thus been forced by
circumstances to become robbers.
The "Shun Pao" (申报), a communist organ
of American-ownership, and the "Ta Mei Wan Pao" (大美晚报),
the mouthpiece of the Chiang regime, are still recklessly
engaged in subversive propaganda, while the unemployed
writers are still willing to work as slaves of the
Kuomintang Government and the beasts of the Communist Party.

1939年7月13日。
下午译文。

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）
发表如下评论：

租界内的不法分子再次活跃

蒋介石政权利用租界的特殊条件，经常直接或间接地实施非法和背叛的阴谋，煽动暗杀。实际上，这些活动不仅未能对和平救国运动产生任何效果，反而暴露了国民党政权面具背后的丑恶。它们只加速了后者的自杀和崩溃。这一切都归功于日本当局和“维新政府”在过去两年中的严密监视和严厉镇压。
在政治上，由于当局持续进行大规模搜查，并多次发现国民党政府的恐怖组织，租界内的不法分子似乎已被剥夺了所有庇护手段。在文化上，自从作为国民党政府在上海最高机构的国民党上海区党部因当局采取的合理措施而被无条件解散后，新政府的和平影响逐渐增强。例如，所有教育机构都改变了以往错误的政策，而报纸，特别是那些在外商注册下的反日报纸，已相继停刊。仍在出版的报纸也对其颠覆性宣传政策进行了根本性的改变。甚至在书店中，所有具有宣传性质的书籍都被替换为适合当前形势的书籍。诚然，工部局对过去几个月上海这个孤岛上的反日和反“维新政府”气氛的消失负有部分责任。然而，当我们看到受蒋介石政府控制的共产党匪徒现在恢复了活动时，我们不能保持自满。
以下事实值得关注：-
一旦受外国控制区域的不法分子无法进行其兽行，他们就被国民党政府视为不忠于职守，并被剥夺财政支持，从而无法维持生计。因此，有些人被迫沦为强盗。
美资共产党的机关报《申报》和蒋政权的喉舌《大美晚报》，仍在肆无忌惮地进行颠覆性宣传，而失业文人仍愿意充当国民党政府的奴隶和共产党的走狗。据本文作者所知，他们

pages.en:
frequently conveyed secretly anti-Japanese publications
to the various schools along Weihaiwei Road, Rue Bourgeat,
and in the Continental Emporium on Nanking Road and the
Footung Guild Building on Avenue Edward VII. The bookstores
on Foochow Road which deal in the sale of Japanese
publications have frequently been illegally threatened by
communist bandits and have often received threatening
letters written in the name of the "Iron and Blood Traitors
Extermination Corps" for the purpose of extortion. During
the past two days, every time when the "Central China Daily
News" (中華日報), which started publication on July 10,
was about to be issued, youths disguised as working class
people, in groups of three or four, have appeared along
Shantung Road. Besides distributing anti-Wang Ching-wei
handbills, they forcibly and unreasonably seized the
newspapers. Moreover, they threatened the ignorant
newspaper distributors that whoever was found to be
engaged in distributing or selling the "Central China Daily
News" would be dealt with by the Kuomintang Government and
that therefore they have the right to kill these persons
at any time or place.
In view of the recurrence of terroristic cases
of this nature, we cannot help being curious as to why
at this time when the S.M.C. has promised that it will
closely co-operate with the Japanese authorities for the
prevention of the activities of anti-Japanese elements in
the maintenance of peace and order, the communist bandits
are still so active. Is it that the S.M.C. fails to
notice this fact or is it that it is powerless to curb
their activities?
At this time when both China and Japan are
working energetically for the creation of a new order in
East Asia, we can allow no obstacle to exist in our path
towards the reconstruction of Asia. For this reason, we
sincerely hope that both the Japanese Government and the
"Reformed Government" will lodge strong protests with the
S.M.C. on the question of the suppression of anti-Japanese
elements in the Settlement. In order to safeguard our
own rights, it is not improper or illegal that the two
Governments should adopt immediate action to check directly
the activities of the communist bandits in the Settlement.
The people of the two countries are all determined to
pledge their support to their governments and are not
afraid of sacrifices. They are eagerly looking for a
victory to be achieved by their governments in this
connection.
pages.zh:
经常秘密地将反日出版物运送到威海卫路、蒲石路（Rue Bourgeat）沿线的各学校，以及南京路的大陆商场和爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）的福建会馆大楼。福州路经营日本出版物的书店经常受到共产党匪徒的非法威胁，并经常收到以“铁血除奸团”名义书写的恐吓信，目的是勒索。在过去两天里，每当7月10日开始发行的《中华日报》即将发行时，三四个一群伪装成工人阶级的青年就会出现在山东路沿线。除了分发反汪精卫的传单外，他们还强行无理地扣押报纸。此外，他们威胁无知的小报贩，称任何人若被发现从事分发或销售《中华日报》的工作，将受到国民党政府的处置，因此他们有权在任何时间或地点杀死这些人。
鉴于此类恐怖案件再次发生，我们不禁好奇，为何在工部局承诺将与日本当局密切合作，防止反日分子活动以维护和平秩序之时，共产党匪徒仍然如此活跃。是工部局没有注意到这一事实，还是无力遏制他们的活动？
在中日两国正努力为建立东亚新秩序而积极工作的时刻，我们不允许在我们的亚洲重建道路上存在任何障碍。为此，我们真诚希望日本政府和“维新政府”就镇压租界内反日分子的问题向工部局提出强烈抗议。为了维护我们自身的权利，两国政府采取直接行动制止共产党匪徒在租界内的活动，并非不当或非法。两国人民都决心支持各自的政府，不怕牺牲。他们热切期盼两国政府在此问题上取得胜利。

pages.en:
July 4, 1939.
Morning Translation.

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper) :-

"THE DOWNFALL OF 'FOREIGN-REGISTERED' NEWSPAPERS :
FOREIGNERS UNWILLING TO BE UTILIZED ANY LONGER".

Since the fall of Shanghai, the "foreign-registered" Chinese language newspapers have become one of the greatest speculative enterprises in this isolated city. The managements of the various papers employ a foreigner at a salary of $300 or $400 a month to act as the publisher and publish their papers under "foreign registration" and ostensibly in support of the war of resistance, thereby hoping to obtain a large subsidy from the Chiang Kai-shek regime.

Following the publication on May 13, 1939 by the various "foreign-registered" newspapers such as the "Standard" (文匯報), the "Chinese-American Daily News" (中美日報), the "Ta Mei Pao" (大美報) and the "News Digest" (譯報) in a conspicuous position of an address delivered by General Chiang Kai-shek, the British and American Ambassadors in China, fearing that this might give rise to international disputes, instructed their respective Consuls-General in Shanghai to order the above-mentioned papers to suspend publication for two weeks as a mark of punishment and also to refrain in future from publishing articles that are liable to give rise to international misunderstandings.

After their receipt of the warning from the British authorities, Mr. Cumine, the publisher of the "Standard," and Mr. Sanders-Bates, the publisher of the "News Digest," realized that for a salary of a few hundred dollars a month they had been made use of as puppets by the Chinese. On this account they submitted demands to the managements of the papers to the effect that if the papers desired to resume publication, they should henceforth obey their (the publishers') instructions and should maintain an impartial stand in their articles, while the anti-Japanese elements in the editorial staff should be dismissed and members of the editorial staff should be appointed by them.

Since receipt of the above demands from Messrs Cumine and Sanders-Bates, the managements of the "Standard" and the "News Digest" have so far failed to resume publication because they fear that with the loss of their subsidies they will be unable to carry on.

It is said, however, that the "Standard" will probably resume publication, whereas the "News Digest" will be definitely closed.

The "Morning Leader" (導報), which was the successor to the defunct "National Herald" (神州日報), was also published by Mr. Sanders-Bates. Recently, as Mr. Sanders-Bates submitted demands similar to those he made to the "News Digest," the management of the paper, considering that the demands were unacceptable, ceased publication as from July 1.

It is learned that the "Ta Ying Yeh Pao" (大英夜報), which occupies the same premises as the "Morning Leader" and which is also published by Mr. Sanders-Bates, has accepted the latter's demands. As the "Morning Leader" has refused to undertake the printing of the "Ta Ying Yeh Pao," the printing of the latter paper is now being done by the "Hwa Mei Wan Pao" (華美晚報).

The foregoing circumstances amply show the downfall of "foreign-registered" newspapers.

1939年7月4日。
晨间译件。

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）：

“‘外商注册’报纸的没落：
外国人不再愿意被利用”。

自上海沦陷以来，“外商注册”的中文报纸已成为这座孤城中最大的投机事业之一。各报馆聘请一名外国人担任发行人，月薪三百或四百元，以“外商注册”的名义出版报纸，表面上支持抗战，从而希望从蒋介石政权那里获得巨额补贴。

继1939年5月13日，《文汇报》、《中美日报》、《大美报》和《译报》等各“外商注册”报纸在显著位置刊登蒋介石将军的一篇演说后，英美驻华大使担心此举可能引发国际争端，遂指示其驻上海总领事命令上述报纸停刊两周以示惩罚，并告诫今后不得刊登可能引起国际误解的文章。

在收到英国当局的警告后，《文汇报》发行人库明（Cumine）先生和《译报》发行人桑德斯-贝茨（Sanders-Bates）先生意识到，为了每月几百美元的薪水，他们已被中国人当作傀儡利用。因此，他们向各报馆管理层提出要求，称如果报纸希望复刊，此后必须听从他们（发行人）的指令，在文章中保持中立立场，解雇编辑部内的反日分子，并由他们任命编辑部成员。

自从收到库明先生和桑德斯-贝茨先生的上述要求以来，《文汇报》和《译报》的管理层至今未能复刊，因为他们担心一旦失去补贴，将无法维持运营。

然而，据悉《文汇报》可能会复刊，而《译报》则肯定会关闭。

作为已停办的《神州日报》的继承者，《导报》也由桑德斯-贝茨先生出版。最近，由于桑德斯-贝茨先生提出了与他向《译报》提出的类似要求，该报管理层认为这些要求不可接受，遂自7月1日起停刊。

据了解，与《导报》在同一址办公、同样由桑德斯-贝茨先生出版的《大英夜报》，已接受了后者的要求。由于《导报》拒绝承印《大英夜报》，目前该报由《华美晚报》负责印刷。

上述情况充分显示了“外商注册”报纸的没落。

July 3, 1939. Afternoon Translation.

Sin Shum Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper) :-

"REFORMED GOVERNMENT" ASKED TO TAKE OVER CONTROL OF
EDUCATIONAL RIGHTS IN THE FOREIGN SETTLEMENTS

Recently two controversial notices, one published by the Hwai Kiu Middle School for Girls (懷久女中) and the other by the Wu Peng Middle School for Girls (務本女中), appeared in local leading foreign-owned newspapers. This dispute has now become extended to one involving the Promotion Guide Committee of the Primary School Circles in Shanghai (上海小學界指導委員會) for the former and the Federation of Sixteen Schools (十六校聯合會) for the latter. On the one hand they are now engaged in publishing notices criticizing one another, while on the other they are busy enrolling new students. This proves the fact that the teachers of both these schools, besides attending to their usual duties towards the education of the students, have now to spare a part of their energy in the authorship of notices to criticize one another, with the result that they will naturally neglect the studies of the girls.

It is known to all that the Wu Peng Middle School for Girls, though it enjoys some reputation, is not a very well-known institution in Shanghai, nor are the graduates of the school extraordinarily well educated. Then why are these two institutions so anxious to retain the title of "Wu Peng"? The reason is no other than the desire to secure the education grants, partly from the missionaries and partly from the S.M.C.

Both the suspension of the Wu Peng and the subsequent establishment of the Hwai Kiu School for Girls are facts. Judging by the two characters "Hwai Kiu," they are actually connected with those of the Wu Peng Girls' School. We believe that it is a fact that this school was reorganized from the latter. However, it appears that the authorities of the Hwai Kiu School for Girls after its inauguration have neglected other necessary procedure because they are only interested in the continued receipt of the grants; they never anticipated that the former members of the Wu Peng Middle School for Girls would start the present movement for the revival of this school.

Since Shanghai has become an isolated island, the business of educational enterprises has been extraordinarily prosperous. It is for this reason that this movement was promoted and it is a fact that can be discerned from the contents of the notices.

These educationalists are only interested in school fees and in obtaining the grants; they are not really devoting their attention towards the promotion of education. They are criticizing each other because of monetary profit. Such vices and corruption prevail among the educational circles of the Kuomintang. We therefore hope that the Ministry of Education of the "Reformed Government" will quickly accelerate the promotion of a new educational system. All the schools in the Foreign Settlements that are under the control of the Kuomintang Education Department should be supervised and reorganised or suppressed, so as to bring about the disappearance of this strange state of affairs in Shanghai.

It is for this reason that the educational rights in the foreign controlled areas should be taken over without delay.

1939年7月3日。下午译件。

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）：

请“维新政府”接管公共租界的教育权

近日，当地主要外商银行报纸上刊登了两则引起争议的启事，一则由怀久女中发布，另一则由务本女中发布。这场纠纷现已扩大到涉及前者上海小学界指导委员会和后者十六校联合会。一方面，他们忙于刊登启事互相指责；另一方面，他们又忙着招收新生。这证明这两所学校的教师除了履行教育学生的一般职责外，现在还要分出部分精力撰写启事互相攻讦，结果自然会使女生们的学业受到忽视。

众所周知，务本女中虽享有一定声誉，但在上海并非一所非常知名的学校，其毕业生的受教育程度也并非特别出众。那么，为何这两所机构如此急切地想要保留“务本”的称号呢？原因无他，只是为了获取教育拨款，这部分拨款部分来自传教士，部分来自工部局。

务本女中的停办以及随后怀久女中的成立，均为事实。从“怀久”二字来看，它们实际上与务本女中有关联。我们认为，该校是由后者改组而成，这是一个事实。然而，怀久女中当局在成立后似乎忽视了其他必要的程序，因为他们只关心继续领取拨款；他们从未预料到原务本女中的成员会发起当前复兴该校的运动。

自从上海成为孤岛以来，教育行业的生意异常兴隆。正是出于这个原因，这一运动得以推动，从启事的内容中可以 discern 出这一事实。

这些教育家只关心学费和获取拨款；他们并没有真正致力于促进教育。他们因金钱利益而互相指责。这种弊病和腐败在国民党的教育界盛行。因此，我们希望“维新政府”教育部尽快加速推行新的教育制度。所有受国民党教育部控制的外国租界内的学校都应受到监管、改组或取缔，以便消除上海这种奇怪的局面。

正因如此，应立即收回外国控制区域的教育权。

June 26, 1939.

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper) :-
DISPUTES AMONG THREE LOCAL SCHOOLS

In every enterprise in Shanghai there is always
some corruption. Educational circles in Shanghai are to-day
entirely in the hands of speculators who regard the schools
as so many commercial stores with the pupils as different
kinds of wares. These speculators have made money under
the cloak of education.

Recently, three schools published notices in
local newspapers criticizing one another because each desires
to secure a site for its school. They are the "former
Shanghai City Government administered Wu Peng Middle School
for Girls," the "private Wu Peng Middle School for Girls" and
the "Hwai Kiu Middle School for Girls." It is a blemish on
educational circles.

Our reporter investigated this ugly affair and
the following is his report :-

The Wu Peng Middle School for Girls was originally
established by the former Chinese educational authorities in
Shanghai with Miss Hu Lai (胡蘭) as principal. It had many
students and the management was honest. On the outbreak of
the Shanghai War, she left Shanghai for Changshu. Koo Feng-
chen (顧鳳城), dean of the school, acted as principal. The
school could not carry on and was reorganized and renamed the
Hwai Kiu Middle School for Girls and one Sung Shou-mei (沈守梅)
was appointed as principal on the suggestions of Pan Kung-chan
(潘公展). Koo Feng-chen, the acting principal, was much
disappointed although he was given the post of secretary of
the Board of Directors of the school.

The Hwai Kiu Middle School for Girls is originally
derived from the former Shanghai City Government administered
Wu Peng Middle School for Girls, so the graduation certificates
are still chopped with a seal of the former Shanghai City

1939年6月26日。

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）：
本地三所学校之间的纠纷

在上海的每一项企业中，总存在
一些腐败现象。如今上海的教育界完全
掌握在投机者手中，他们将学校视为商
店，将学生视为各种商品。这些投机者
打着教育的幌子赚钱。

最近，三所学校在当地报纸上刊登启
事互相指责，因为每所学校都想为其学
校争取一个校址。它们是“前上海市政府
管辖的务本女中”、“私立务本女中”和
“怀久女中”。这是教育界的一个污点。

本报记者调查了这起丑闻，以下是
他的报告：

务本女中最初由上海前中国教育当局
建立，胡兰小姐任校长。学生众多，管
理廉洁。上海战事爆发后，她离开上海
前往常熟。学校教务长顾凤城代理校长
职务。学校无法维持，遂进行改组并更
名为怀久女中，并根据潘公展的建议，
任命沈守梅为校长。代理校长顾凤城虽
被给予学校董事会秘书的职位，但仍感
到非常失望。

怀久女中原系从前上海市政府管辖的
务本女中衍生而来，因此毕业证书上仍
盖有前上海市政府

Government administered Wu Peng Middle School for Girls.
During the spring of this year, the principal
Sung Shou-mei of the Hwai Kiu Middle School for Girls left for
Hongkong for a new position and Koo Feng-chen continued to act
as principal of the school. Soon after this, the new principal
Yang Ming-hwei (楊敏輝) arrived. It is said that for a long
time this new principal has been making great endeavours to
secure the post of principal of the Wu Peng Middle School for
Girls. His wish has at last been realized for she is now the
principal of the Hwai Kiu Middle School for Girls - the off-
spring of the former Shanghai City Government administered Wu
Peng Middle School for Girls.
Koo Feng-chen thought that Yang Ming-hwei,
being a female, could be imposed upon, so he would not hand
over the school to the new principal. Yang therefore tried
to regulate the affair by means of money. After Koo Feng-
chen had received $20,000 from principal Yang, he handed the
school to Yang, but retained the chop inscribed "Wu Peng Middle
School for Girls of the Shanghai City Government," which he
took away with him as he had already harboured evil intentions.
Yang Ming-hwei did not expect that after spending $20,000 to
secure the post, She would still have many obstacles to face.
For a time the teachers of the Hwai Kiu Middle
School for Girls criticized Koo Feng-chen for receiving bribes
and disapproved of Yang Ming-hwei as the new principal; they
therefore induced the students to suspend their studies. Yang
had to beg assistance from various quarters and eventually she
asked an influential person to settle the affair. Fearing
that the school might be closed by the authorities of the
French Concession and not being in a position to give an
explanation to the families of the students, the teachers
allowed Yang Ming-hwei to assume her post. Meanwhile, it
was found that the seal of the "Wu Peng Middle School for
Girls" had been removed by Koo Feng-chen. On this account,

管辖的务本女中的印章。
今年春季，怀久女中校长沈守梅前往
香港就任新职，顾凤城继续代理校长职
务。不久之后，新校长杨敏辉到任。据
说，这位新校长长期以来一直努力争取
务本女中校长的职位。她的愿望终于实
现，因为她现在是怀久女中的校长——
即前上海市政府管辖的务本女中的后继
者。
顾凤城认为杨敏辉是女性，可以欺
负，因此不肯将学校移交给新校长。于
是杨试图用金钱来调节此事。顾凤城从
杨校长那里收到两万元后，将学校移交
给了杨，但保留了刻有“上海市政府务本
女中”字样的印章，由于他早已居心不
良，便将印章带走。杨敏辉没想到，在
花费两万元谋得职位后，她仍将面临许
多障碍。
有一段时间，怀久女中的教师批评顾
凤城收受贿赂，并不认可杨敏辉为新校
长；因此他们煽动学生停课。杨不得不
向各方求助，最终她请了一位有影响力
的人物来解决此事。教师们担心学校可
能被法租界当局关闭，且无法向学生家
长做出解释，便允许杨敏辉上任。与此
同时，人们发现“务本女中”的印章已被
顾凤城拿走。因此，

a new oblong seal was made.
When Yang Ming-hwei came to the school to assume
charge, Ching Kwang-mei (金光楣), Wong ih-ming (王錫民)
and other teachers of the Hwai Kiu School, who are opposed to
Yang Ming-hwei, tendered their resignations en bloc.
The present so-called "former Shanghai City
Government administered Wu Peng Middle School for Girls" is
established by a number of teachers and employees who had left
the Hwai Kiu Middle School for Girls. As they had relations
in the past with the former Shanghai City Government administered
Wu Peng Middle School for Girls and furthermore as they were
receiving support from certain influential quarters, they
immediately restored the original name of the former Shanghai
City Government Administered Wu Peng Middle School for Girls,
in opposition to the Hwai Kiu Middle School for Girls.
As regards the private Wu Peng Middle School for
Girls, it was established by certain former undesirable elements
of the Hwai Kiu Middle School for Girls. As it could not win
the confidence of the community, it has only a few students.
At present the Hwai Kiu School and the former
Shanghai City Government administered Wu Peng Middle School
for Girls are engaged in a dispute in the newspapers, the former
accusing the latter of being an imposter and vice versa. The
private Wu Peng Middle School for Girls kept aloof; it stopped
publishing statements or refutations in the papers.
It is absurd that controversies similar to that
over the trade names "Lao Dah Vong" (老大房) for candy shops
and "Loh Kao Chi" (陸稿荐) for pork shops should have arisen
among high and noble educational circles. This is a section
of the dark goings-on in Shanghai.

制作了一枚新的长方形印章。
当杨敏辉到校上任时，金光楣、王锡民
以及其他反对杨敏辉的怀久学校教师集
体辞职。
目前的所谓“前上海市政府管辖的务本
女中”是由一批离开怀久女中的教师和职
员建立的。由于他们过去与前上海市政

些有影响力方面的支持，他们立即恢复
了前上海市政府管辖的务本女中的原名
称，以对抗怀久女中。
至于私立务本女中，它是由怀久女中
的一些前不良分子建立的。由于无法赢
得社会的信任，其学生寥寥无几。
目前，怀久学校和前上海市政府管辖
的务本女中正在报纸上进行争论，前者
指责后者是冒牌货，反之亦然。私立务
本女中则置身事外；它停止在报纸上发
表声明或反驳。
在高贵神圣的教育界，竟然出现了类
似糖果店“老大房”和肉铺“陆稿荐”那样
的商号之争，这真是荒谬。这是上海黑
暗内幕的一部分。

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper)
publishes the following comment :-

THE FOREIGN AUTHORITIES AND THE PRICE OF RICE

During the past few days, the price of rice
in Shanghai has been rising unchecked, to the serious
menace of the people's food problem as well as to peace
and order. It is said that there are ample rice stocks
in Shanghai and on this account the public are blaming
the profiteers for the high prices.
In a well-organized country, all foodstuffs
and daily necessities are handled directly by the
government which put a fixed price on foodstuffs. The
poor class of people are becoming very uneasy at the
high price of rice, yet the authorities of the Foreign
Settlements have not taken any measures to deal with the
situation. This is really surprising and reveals a
lack of energy in the administrative organ of the Foreign
Settlements, otherwise the officials would not have
remained so unconcerned. It is clear that the suggestions
for a reorganisation of the administration of the Foreign
Settlements are not far-fetched.
pages.zh:
《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）
发表如下评论：——

外国当局与米价

近几日，上海米价 unchecked 上涨，严重威胁民众的粮食问题以及和平秩序。据悉上海存有充足的米粮，因此公众将高米价归咎于奸商。
在一个组织良好的国家，所有食品和日用品均由政府直接管理，并对食品实行固定价格。贫困阶层因米价高涨而深感不安，然而外国租界当局却未采取任何措施来应对这一局势。这实在令人惊讶，也暴露出外国租界行政机构缺乏活力，否则官员们不会如此漠不关心。显然，关于重组外国租界行政管理的建议并非无稽之谈。

pages.en:
Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper):-

ANNIVERSARY OF THE SHAMEEN INCIDENT

To-day is the anniversary of the Shameen
Incident. In support of the May 30 Incident which broke
out in Shanghai in 1925, the students in Canton ceased
studies while the workers went on strike.
On June 23, a citizens' meeting was held at
Canton as a demonstration. When the masses reached
Shaki on the opposite bank of Shameen, a clash took place
between them and the British soldiers who opened machine
gun fire, killing and wounding many of the crowd.
This anniversary is observed by the Chinese
every year with expressions of deep indignation at the
cruel acts of the British Imperialists. To-day, the
Chinese people are recalling the cruel facts of the
British Imperialists who are now rendering assistance
to Chiang Kai-shek, which is tantamount to helping the
evil-doer to do evil and to prolong the war. The
people are highly indignant.
pages.zh:
《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）：——

沙基惨案周年纪念

今天是沙基惨案周年纪念日。为支持1925年在上海爆发的五卅惨案，广州学生停课，工人罢工。
6月23日，广州市民举行集会示威。当群众到达沙基对岸的沙面时，他们与英军发生冲突，英军开枪扫射，造成群众多人死伤。
中国人每年都在这一天纪念这一事件，表达对英国帝国主义者残酷行径的深切愤慨。今天，中国人民回想起英国帝国主义者的残酷事实，他们现在正援助蒋介石，这无异于助纣为虐并延长战争。民众对此极为愤慨。

June 23, 1939. Morning Translation.

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper):

DISPUTE OVER CLOSING OF A THOROUGHFARE SETTLED

Thanks to the good offices of the S.M.C., the question of the thoroughfare of the Shanghai-Hangchow-Ningpo Railway of the Central China Railway Company, which was unlawfully closed to traffic recently, has been satisfactorily settled.

At 3 p.m. June 22, the British defence force issued the following notice to the Japanese authorities through the S.M.C. :-

"For the maintenance of peace and order, the thoroughfare was closed to traffic. The closure gave rise to much inconvenience to the Japanese quarters of the Toyoda Cotton Mill, but this was not intended by the British defence force. For this reason, the ban on passage through this thoroughfare is lifted and free passage is restored."

Having an excellent understanding of the intentions of the British authorities, the Japanese authorities paid little attention to the unpleasant affair.

Shortly after 3 p.m., the British defence force removed the board which had been put up there to notify that the road was closed to traffic. The barbed wire entanglements were allowed to remain because they are considered necessary as a precautionary measure.

1939年6月23日。晨间译稿。

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）：

封闭道路纠纷已解决

得益于上海公共租界工部局（S.M.C.）的斡旋，华中铁路公司沪杭甬铁路的一条最近被非法封闭交通的道路问题，已得到圆满解决。

6月22日下午3时，英国防卫部队通过工部局向日本当局发出如下通知：——

“为维护和平与秩序，该道路已被封闭交通。此次封闭给丰田纱厂日本居住区带来诸多不便，但这并非英国防卫部队之本意。鉴于此，现解除对该道路通行的禁令，恢复自由通行。”

日本当局充分理解英国当局的意图，对这一不愉快的事件未予过多关注。

下午3时过后不久，英国防卫部队撤下了此前设立的禁止通行告示牌。铁丝网障碍物仍被保留，因为被认为作为预防措施是必要的。

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper)
publishes the following article :- 17. 6.

"WILL JAPAN SEIZE THE SHANGHAI SETTLEMENTS ON JULY 7?"

The other day a report came from London to the
effect that at a session of the House of Lords a member of
the House declared that Japan might take steps to seize
the Shanghai Settlements on July 7, the second anniversary
of the outbreak of Sino-Japanese hostilities.
We can only regard the above report as a
rumour which, we can definitely say, had been fabricated
by Britain with the object of inciting the Kuomintang
Government and the other Powers, having interests in the
Settlement, to adopt a hostile attitude towards Japan,
thereby enabling her (Britain) to maintain her privileges
in the Settlement forever.
It is the wish of every Chinese citizen to
recover the Settlement. Whatever rumours the British
may fabricate to create dissension, the Chinese people
will never be so foolish as to say: "We suggest that
the British retain their Settlements in China forever."
Japan has no ambition to occupy the
Settlements; she is taking action against the British
and other foreign Concessions because they closely affect
her interests during the Sino-Japanese hostilities. We
should understand that Japan, in a purely friendly
attitude, is co-operating with China in the peaceful
reconstruction of the Far East and she has not the

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）
发表如下文章：—— 6月17日。

“日本会在7月7日夺取上海租界吗？”

日前有来自伦敦的报道声称，在上议院的一次会议上，一名议员宣称，日本可能会在中日敌对行动爆发两周年之际，即7月7日，采取行动夺取上海租界。
我们只能将上述报道视为谣言，我们可以肯定地说，这是英国为了煽动国民党政府及其他在租界拥有利益的列强对日本采取敌对态度而捏造的，从而使英国能够永远维持在租界的特权。
收回租界是每一位中国公民的愿望。无论英国人捏造何种谣言以制造分裂，中国人民绝不会愚蠢到说：“我们建议英国永远保留其在华租界。”
日本无意占领租界；她之所以对英国及其他外国租界采取行动，是因为这些租界在中日敌对行动期间密切影响其利益。我们应该理解，日本正以纯粹友好的态度与中国合作，进行远东的和平重建，她并没有

pages.en:
slightest ambition to seize the territorial rights of
China. If we recall the statement made by Prince
Konoye, the former Japanese Premier, we can see that
while Japan has no intention to seize Chinese territory,
the question of her seizure of small areas of land such
as the Settlements does not arise.
The government and the people of new
China appreciate the sacred war upon which Japan has
embarked for the purpose of punishing the anti-Japanese
Kuomintang regime. The recovery of foreign Concessions,
wherein anti-Japanese elements and Communists are hiding
and are engaged in activities harmful to Japan and China,
is a task of great importance equal to that for the
overthrow of the Kuomintang-Communist regime. The
action taken by Japan in Tientsin is simply one of self-
defence, and the report that she intends to seize the
Settlements is a malicious allegation. Actually,
foreign Concessions are located within the areas now
temporarily occupied by Japan and there is necessity
for Japan to take steps to occupy the Settlements.
Japan has every freedom of movement,
but what steps, not to say what force, can the foreigners
in the Settlements take to stop her. A blockade like
that directed against the British Concession in Tientsin
will be sufficient to put the Settlements to death.
Moreover, the government of new China will endeavour
to recover the foreign Concessions.
We advise those timid British people
to be calm for Japan will make no attempt to seize the
Shanghai Settlements on July 7. Japan, however, will
not permit the Settlements to harbour anti-Japanese
elements and bad characters harmful to Sino-Japanese
peace. She is on the alert and will intervene and
take free action without waiting for the arrival of
July 7. Although we are absolutely certain that
Japan will not attempt to seize the Settlements on
July 7, the second anniversary of the outbreak of the
Sino-Japanese hostilities, we hope that the new Chinese
Government, with the assistance of the friendly nation,
will take steps to recover the Settlements.
pages.zh:
丝毫夺取中国领土权利的野心。如果我们回顾前日本首相近卫公爵的声明，就可以看出，既然日本无意夺取中国领土，那么夺取如租界这样小片土地的问题也就无从谈起。
新中国的政府和人民赞赏日本为惩罚反日的国民党政权而发动的神圣战争。收回那些藏匿反日分子和共产党人、并从事危害中日利益活动的外国租界，是一项与推翻国共政权同等重要的任务。日本在天津采取的行动仅仅是自卫，所谓其意图夺取租界的报道是恶意的诬蔑。实际上，外国租界位于日本目前暂时占领的区域内，日本有必要采取措施占领这些租界。
日本拥有充分的行动自由，而租界内的外国人又能采取什么步骤，更不用说使用什么武力，来阻止她呢？像针对天津英租界那样的封锁，就足以置租界于死地。此外，新中国政府将努力收回外国租界。
我们劝告那些胆小的英国人保持冷静，因为日本不会试图在7月7日夺取上海租界。然而，日本不会允许租界窝藏危害中日和平的反日分子和不良分子。她正保持警惕，并将进行干预和采取自由行动，而不会等到7月7日到来。虽然我们绝对确信日本不会试图在中日敌对行动爆发两周年的7月7日夺取租界，但我们希望新中国政府在友好国家的协助下，采取措施收回租界。

June 9, 1939.
Morning Translation

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper)
publishes the following article :-

"TAKE UP, RESIDENTS OF THE FOREIGN SETTLEMENTS : THE
BRITISH ARE SUCKING OUR BLOOD"

Last month the Shanghai Tramway Company,
a British concern, took on 300 conductors.
Outwardly, this action of the company is
impartial and beneficial for it gives work to the jobless.
However, according to information given out by a conductor,
the British are employing vile intrigues to exploit the
Chinese and also to suck the blood of the Chinese people.
I use the -- route railless trolleys
everyday. I thus became acquainted with several conductors.
One day I discovered a conductor, who was an expert at
squeeze and who had become honest. Out of curiosity, I
approached him, and the conversation which ensued will
serve as a lesson to those residents of the Settlement who
are advocating Sino-British friendship.
The conductor made the following state-
ment :- "I am ashamed to speak about it. We, Chinese,
always depend upon others for assistance and as a
consequence our own territory has been leased to others
as Concessions, etc. Following the outbreak of the present
hostilities, the population in Shanghai has greatly
increased. Thus, every tramcar is filled to capacity at
all times and money is simply flowing into the purse of
the British, whereas we workers are still being paid low
wages. How can we live on our small pay in Shanghai
where the cost of living is so high! There is no other
way but to make squeeze everyday.
"Squeeze is a mean and cowardly act, but
the money we squeeze belongs to the British. When we are
found out by a ticket inspector in the act of squeezing,
we shall be either reprimanded or fined or put on report
or dismissed. Therefore, squeezing is quite an
adventure. It should not be tried without 4 or 5 years
of experience.
"Lately the company engaged 300 new
hands. This will be a danger to us, for it is part of
a plan which the company has in mind. According to
the regulations of the company, a new hand, after a
probationary period of two years, may become a conductor
when vacancies arise through retirement or resignation.
A conductor, after 20 years of service, will be given a
bonus equivalent to 20% of the total amount of wages he
had earned during the period of his service. A bonus
equivalent to 12% or 13% of the total amount of wages he
had earned during the period of service will be issued
to a conductor who is invalided after less than 20 years.
Though this is a good treatment, very few conductors have
worked long enough to receive the bonus.
"When the wage of a conductor reaches
$30 or $40 a month (this is reached after 10 years
service), he will be dismissed for a small mistake.

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）
发表如下文章：——

“外国租界居民请起而响应：英国人正在吸我们的血”

上月，英商上海电车公司雇佣了300名售票员。
表面上看，该公司的这一举动公正且有益，因为它为失业者提供了工作。然而，据一名售票员透露，英国人正 employing vile intrigues 剥削中国人，并吸食中国人民的血汗。
我每天都乘坐 -- 路无轨电车。因此我结识了几位售票员。有一天，我发现一位擅长“揩油”但已变得诚实的售票员。出于好奇，我接近他，随后的谈话足以给那些主张中英友好的租界居民上一课。
该售票员作了如下陈述：“说起这事我感到羞愧。我们中国人总是依赖他人援助，结果导致我们的国土被租借给他人作为租界等。随着当前战事的爆发，上海人口大幅增加。因此，每辆电车任何时候都挤满了人，钱财源源不断地流入英国人的腰包，而我们工人仍然拿着微薄的工资。在生活成本如此高的上海，我们靠这点微薄薪水怎么生活！别无他法，只能每天‘揩油’。
“‘揩油’是一种卑鄙懦弱的行为，但我们揩来的钱属于英国人。当我们被查票员发现正在‘揩油’时，我们会受到斥责、罚款、记录在案或被解雇。因此，‘揩油’相当冒险。没有四五年的经验是不敢尝试的。
“最近公司雇佣了300名新手。这对我们来说是个危险，因为这是公司计划的一部分。根据公司规定，新手在经过两年的试用期后，若有退休或辞职产生的空缺，可成为正式售票员。售票员服务满20年后，将获得相当于其服务期间工资总额20%的奖金。服务不满20年因病退职的售票员，将获得相当于其服务期间工资总额12%或13%的奖金。虽然待遇不错，但很少有售票员工作年限长到足以获得奖金。
“当售票员的月薪达到30或40美元时（这需要在服务10年后才能达到），他们会因一个小错误而被解雇。

pages.en:
It is clear to any person of intelligence why they are
dismissed: it is because they are about to qualify for
the bonus.
"After an engagement of new hands,
conductor No.335 was instantly dismissed because he was
unable to sell tickets to a large number of fares. He
was replaced a new hand. In this way, the company
not only saves the bonus but pays out less in wages for
a new hand who gets only $12 a month for the first year.
For the sake of my job, I do not dare to squeeze any
longer. 'The tiger of the eastern mountain' is a man-
eater but the 'tiger of the western mountain' also likes
human flesh. Are the British good people? They are
ten times more ferocious than a tiger!"
The above clearly reveals that although
the British are loudly acclaiming their sympathy for
Chinese, nevertheless they are secretly employing vile
methods to suck the blood of the Chinese people and to
exploit the "skin and flesh" of the Chinese people.
Wake up, you Chinese people who are
clamouring for Sino-British friendship!
This article is like a cup of ice cream
in summer and we hope that after taking it you will no
longer be so addle-brained.
pages.zh:
任何有理智的人都清楚他们被解雇的原因：这是因为他们即将符合领取奖金的资格。
“在雇佣新手后，335号售票员立即被解雇，因为他无法向大量乘客售出车票。他被一名新手取代。这样，公司不仅省下了奖金，而且支付给新手的工资也更少，新手第一年的月薪仅为12美元。为了保住我的工作，我不敢再‘揩油’了。‘东山老虎’吃人，但‘西山老虎’也喜欢吃人肉。英国人是好人吗？他们比老虎凶残十倍！”
上述内容清楚地表明，虽然英国人大声宣扬对中国的同情，但他们暗中采用卑鄙手段吸食中国人民的血汗，剥削中国人的“皮肉”。
醒醒吧，那些 clamouring for 中英友好的中国人！
这篇文章就像夏日里的一杯冰淇淋，我们希望你们在看完之后，头脑不再那么糊涂。

Special Branch
June 5, 1939. 6 6 39

Commissioner.

Sir,

Sin Shun Pao.

I think comment is needless in regard to the
two translations attached.

It is only too evident that while the
Japanese military press for the elimination of anything
"hai-nichi" south of the Creek, its protege the "Sin
Shun Pao" runs wild with scurrilous and other vapourings
which might be expected from irresponsible youth in
its early teens.

In my endeavours to moderate the tone of the
various foreign owned Chinese dailies I have had it thrown
back at me more times than I care to count "What are
you doing about the Sin Shun Pao and its cousin the
Tairiku Shimpo?"

Until the Japanese military puts its house
in order and suppresses this cesspool of scurrility and
disgrace to the name of Japan, little can be hoped
for in the matter of moderating the tone of the foreign
owned Chinese press.

（批：FILE 3/2）

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE M3 5 JUNE 1939）

Thos Robertson
D. C. (Special Branch)

（批：ok wp）

特务科
1939年6月5日。6 6 39

警务处长。

先生，

《新顺报》。

我认为对于所附的两份译文无需多加评论。

显而易见的是，尽管日本军方施压要求清除苏州河以南任何“反日”事物，但其庇护下的《新顺报》却肆意刊登污言秽语及其他胡言乱语，其行径如同不负责任的十几岁少年。

在我试图缓和各家外商拥有的中文日报的论调时，我不止一次地遭到反驳：“你们对《新顺报》及其姊妹报《大陆新报》做了什么？”

在日本军方整顿内部并取缔这个令日本蒙羞的污秽渊薮之前，要想缓和外商拥有的中文报刊的论调，几乎没有什么希望。

（批注：档案 3/2）

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处长办公室 M3 1939年6月5日）

Thos Robertson
副警务处长（特务科）

June 4, 1939. Morning Translation.

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper)
published the following article on June 3 :-

"THE THREE 'DISHONEST AND CRAFTY' MANAGERS OF ANTI-
JAPANESE PAPERS"

The University Press (中華大學書局公司) is
a "faked-up" organization promoted and formed by "dishonest
and crafty" businessmen and writers together with some
advertising brokers for the benefit of their own interests.
They have employed two unknown British subjects, one named
Sanders-Bates and the other N.E. Bonner, ostensibly as
their publishers and chief editors at a cost of $750 a
month for the publication of the "News Digest" (譯報),
the "Morning Leader" (導報) and the "Ta Ying Yeh Pao"
(大美晚報) and other magazines and books in the same
way as "chuckers-out" in brothels and "hired protectors"
in gambling dens are hired in Shanghai. They engage
themselves in anti-Japanese propaganda work in order to
defraud the public of their money on the one hand and to
please, as prostitutes do, the Communist Party, the
Chiang Kai-shek government and the anti-Japanese warlords
and politicians so as to be able to secure some funds
with which to enrich themselves. They are working under
the cloak of national salvation by means of anti-Japanese
propaganda. As this fake organization has now been exposed,
there is no necessity to waste more time about it.
I would like to introduce to readers
the three most active "dishonest and crafty" elements
of this fake organization.
As previously mentioned, though these
"dishonest" persons have employed "chuckers-out" and
"hired protectors" for their enterprises which are
operated under a British signboard, they have no connection
with one another. The "News Digest," the "Morning Leader"
and the "Ta Ying Yeh Pao" have each their own proprietors
and managements; even the "News Digest Weekly" (譯報週刊),
the "News Digest Library" (譯報叢書) and the "News
Digest" are not under the same management. Each of these
the three "dishonest and crafty" figures who will be
introduced represents a newspaper. They are Zau Paung-yung
(曹聚仁) for the "News Digest," Tseng Hsai-dong (曾虛白)
for the "Morning Leader" and Pao Koo-hwa (包可華) for
the "Ta Ying Yeh Pao." Actually, not only are these three
"dishonest and crafty" figures the chief elements who
are responsible for this organization, but they have also
achieved meritorious services for the organization.
The name "University Press" was suggested
by Zau Paung-yung and it was also through his efforts that
the two "chuckers-out" and "hired protectors", Sanders-Bates
and N.E. Bonner, were employed. Indeed he is the person
who has done a lot for this organization.
Now let us see what kind of person Zau
Paung-yung is. A glance at him will convince one that
he is a standard type of the "dishonest and crafty" person.
A five-minute talk with him will make one regard him as
a genius for "dishonesty and craftiness."

(To be continued.)

1939年6月4日。晨间译文。

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）于6月3日刊登了以下文章：-

“三家‘奸诈’反日报纸的‘经理’”

中华大学书局公司是一个由“奸诈”商人和文人联合一些广告掮客为谋取私利而拼凑成立的虚假组织。他们雇佣了两名不知名的英国臣民，一名叫 Sanders-Bates，另一名叫 N.E. Bonner，名义上担任出版人和主编，月薪750元，负责出版《译报》、《导报》和《大美晚报》以及其他杂志和书籍。这种做法就像在上海妓院雇佣“拉客者”和在赌场雇佣“保镖”一样。他们从事反日宣传工作，一方面是为了诈骗公众钱财，另一方面是为了像妓女取悦嫖客那样取悦共产党、蒋介石政府以及反日军阀和政治家，从而获取资金以中饱私囊。他们打着抗日救国的幌子进行反日宣传。既然这个虚假组织已被揭露，就无需再在其身上浪费时间。
我想向读者介绍这个虚假组织中三个最活跃的“奸诈”分子。
如前所述，虽然这些“奸诈”之徒为其在英国招牌下运营的企业雇佣了“拉客者”和“保镖”，但他们彼此之间并无关联。《译报》、《导报》和《大美晚报》各有其业主和管理层；甚至《译报周刊》、《译报丛书》和《译报》也不属于同一管理层。即将介绍的这三位“奸诈”人物各代表一家报纸。他们是：《译报》的曹聚仁（Zau Paung-yung）、《导报》的曾虚白（Tseng Hsai-dong）和《大美晚报》的包可华（Pao Koo-hwa）。实际上，这三位“奸诈”人物不仅是该组织的主要负责人，而且为该组织立下了“汗马功劳”。
“中华大学书局”这个名字是由曹聚仁提出的，也是通过他的努力，才雇佣了 Sanders-Bates 和 N.E. Bonner 这两名“拉客者”和“保镖”。的确，他是为该组织做了很多工作的人。
现在让我们看看曹聚仁是个什么样的人。看他一眼就能让人确信他是标准的“奸诈”之徒。与他交谈五分钟，就会让人认为他是“奸诈”的天才。

（待续。）

pages.en:
June 1, 1939.
Afternoon Translation

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper)
publishes under the following heading a speech broadcasted
by the Great People's Association :-

"THE FOREIGN SETTLEMENTS IN SHANGHAI"

We have already delivered two addresses on the
question of the Foreign Settlements in Shanghai. The
problem has become more and more serious. At this time
when the establishment of a new order in East Asia and the
emancipation of Asiatics are in progress, the Foreign
Settlements, which are themselves a token of the aggression
of China by the white people, should in no way be allowed
to exist. Therefore, so long as the Foreign Settlements
remain, there can be no solution of the question of
these areas.

The administrative organ of the International
Settlement in Shanghai is the Municipal Council whose
organization is based upon the Land Regulations. By
virtue of the Nanking Treaty concluded in the year
1842, Shanghai was opened as a treaty port and a British
Concession was formally established in 1845. Later,
France and the United States also established concessions
in Shanghai and in 1846 the three concessions were placed
under the control of a new Municipal Council. In 1862
a separate Municipal Council was established in the
French Concession and in 1863, the British and the American
Concessions were amalgamated and became known as the
International Settlement.

The supreme administrative organ of the
International Settlement is the S.M.C. At first, there
were only five members, but later, as a result of repeated
reorganization, the number was gradually increased.
According to the Land Regulations, the number of Councillors
should be 14, of whom 9 are to be foreigners and the
remaining five Chinese elected by the Chinese Ratepayers'
Association. The S.M.C. enjoys a right that is
denied to any municipal government in any part of the
world: its activities go beyond municipal affairs and
extend to the maintenance of peace and order and other
matters. It is free from legislative or executive
control by a government.

The British, American and French residents in
the Foreign Settlements who control the Foreign
Settlements, constitute a minority. In the International
Settlement especially, Britain enjoys supreme authority.
She has about 1,400 votes out of a total of about 3,670
votes. This is sufficient to show the unfairness of the
Land Regulations of the International Settlement.

The Foreign Settlements are now being used as
shelters by terroristic elements who are working in
opposition to the "Reformed Government". This is
due to the improper and unstable organization. In order
to find a solution of the question of the Foreign
Settlements, so that it can no longer obstruct the
creation of a new order in East Asia, the "Reformed
Government" should take over the Foreign Settlements.
However, the authorities of the Foreign Settlements are
still opposing the Japanese demand for a revision of the
Land Regulations for they want to hold on to their
unreasonable rights. This is too selfish indeed.

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）在以下标题下刊登了大民会广播的一篇演讲：-

“上海的外国租界”

我们已经就上海外国租界问题发表了两次讲话。这个问题变得越来越严重。在当前建立东亚新秩序和亚洲人解放进程之中，外国租界作为白人侵略中国的标志，绝不应允许其存在。因此，只要外国租界依然存在，这些地区的问题就无法解决。

上海公共租界的行政机构是工部局，其组织基于《土地章程》。根据1842年签订的《南京条约》，上海被开辟为通商口岸，并于1845年正式建立了英租界。后来，法国和美国也在上海建立了租界，1846年，这三个租界置于一个新的工部局控制之下。1862年，法租界成立了独立的工部局，1863年，英租界和美租界合并，称为公共租界。

公共租界的最高行政机构是上海公共租界工部局（S.M.C.）。起初只有五名成员，但后来经过多次改组，人数逐渐增加。根据《土地章程》，董事人数应为14人，其中9人为外国人，其余5人由中国纳税人协会选举产生。上海公共租界工部局享有世界上任何市政政府都被剥夺的权利：其活动超出市政事务范围，延伸至维持和平与秩序及其他事项。它不受政府的立法或行政控制。

控制外国租界的英、美、法居民属于少数群体。特别是在公共租界，英国享有最高权威。在总共约3,670票中，她拥有约1,400票。这足以显示公共租界《土地章程》的不公平性。

目前，外国租界正被反对“维新政府”的恐怖分子用作庇护所。这是由于组织机构不当且不稳定。为了找到解决外国租界问题的办法，使其不再阻碍东亚新秩序的建立，“维新政府”应收回外国租界。然而，外国租界当局仍然反对日本修改《土地章程》的要求，因为他们想保住其不合理的权利。这确实太自私了。

CHINA PRESS.
MAY 4 1939

Puppet Paper
Here Prints
False Reports

Unsolicited and wholly untruth-
ful publicity was accorded to THE
CHINA PRESS yesterday by the Jap-
anese-controlled Chinese daily,
Shin Shun Pao, which reported in
a front page article that a reporter
of this journal has allegedly gone
to Hongkong "with a mission in
connection with the Sino-Japanese
peace problems."
The Shin Shun Pao named a
"Mr. Richard" as THE CHINA
PRESS reporter who is supposed to
be in the Colony on the mysterious
"mission."
The "Mr. Richard," named by
the Shin Shun Pao is a stranger
to THE CHINA PRESS, which at
the present time has no accredited
representative in Hongkong for any
kind of mission.
In presenting its article, the Shin
Shun Pao stated that the informa-
tion came from "indisputable"
sources. A CHINA PRESS reporter
named "Richard," the journal went
on to say, has left hurriedly for
Hongkong in order to confer with
Mr. W. H. Donald, adviser to the
National Government, on the Sino-
Japanese peace problems.
Continuing, the Shin Shun Pao
reported that according to another
rumor, Mr. Donald has arrived in
Shanghai with "secret orders on
peace activities."

昨日，日控中文日报《新顺报》对《字林西报》进行了未经请求且完全失实的宣传，该报在前版文章中称，本报一名记者据称已前往香港，“执行与中日和平问题相关的任务”。
《新顺报》点名一位“Richard先生”为《字林西报》记者，据说此人正在殖民地执行这项神秘的“任务”。
《新顺报》点名的这位“Richard先生”对《字林西报》来说是个陌生人，本报目前在香港没有任何 accredited 代表执行任何类型的任务。
《新顺报》在发表其文章时称，信息来自“无可争议”的消息来源。该报接着说，一位名叫“Richard”的《字林西报》记者已匆忙前往香港，以便就中日和平问题与国民政府顾问 W. H. Donald 先生会晤。
《新顺报》继续报道说，另有谣言称，Donald 先生已带着“关于和平活动的秘密指令”抵达上海。

May 2, 1939.
Morning Translation.

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper):
"INSINCERITY OF THE S.M.C. : JAPANESE SHOULD ADOPT
NEW MEASURES"

Mr. Miura, the Japanese Consul-General, has on
several occasions made strong requests of the Settlement
authorities to suppress the anti-Japanese newspapers in
the Settlement and the national spiritual mobilization
movement, to take adequate steps to deal with the hoisting
of national flags and to effect the suppression of anti-
Japanese elements who are planning to carry out certain
activities in the month of May.
On May 1, the anniversary of the International
Labour Day, Chinese flags were displayed all over the
Settlement. Chinese language newspapers such as the
"Morning Leader" and the "Standard" criticised the request
of the Japanese Consul-General, while handbills of a strong
anti-Japanese nature were disseminated in the main part
of Nanking Road. The action of the S.M.C. in appointing
Chinese and foreign policemen, and not Japanese members
of the Police Force, for patrol duty on the streets on
May 1 constitutes sufficient proof of the Council's
insincerity and disregard of the demands made by the
Japanese authorities.
According to information from other quarters,
certain prisoners are reported to have committed suicide
as a result of non-cooperation between the Japanese police
officers on the one hand and the anti-Japanese elements
among the Chinese and foreign policemen on the other.
The non-cooperation with the Japanese has exposed to the
public the Council's lack of sincerity.
The anniversary of International Labour Day
passed off with comparative quiet when compared with former
occasions. No anti-Japanese activities occurred because
the Japanese Gendarmerie has effected the arrest of
important anti-Japanese bandits who were hiding in the
Foreign Settlements. Should anti-Japanese elements
become active, the Japanese authorities will find it
necessary to take new measures.

1939年5月2日。
晨间译文。

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）：
“工部局缺乏诚意：日本人应采取新措施”

日本总领事三浦先生曾多次强烈要求租界当局镇压租界内的反日报纸和国民精神动员运动，采取适当措施处理悬挂国旗事宜，并镇压计划在五月份开展某些活动的反日分子。
5月1日是国际劳动节纪念日，整个租界到处悬挂中国国旗。《导报》和《标准》等中文报纸批评了日本总领事的请求，同时具有强烈反日性质的传单在南京路主要地段散发。工部局在5月1日派遣中外巡捕而非日本警察部队成员上街巡逻，这一行为充分证明了工部局缺乏诚意，无视日本当局的要求。
据其他方面消息，据报道，由于日本警官与中外巡捕中的反日分子之间缺乏合作，导致某些囚犯自杀。这种不与日本人合作的行为向公众暴露了工部局缺乏诚意。
与以往相比，国际劳动节纪念日过得相对平静。没有发生反日活动，因为日本宪兵队逮捕了藏匿在外国租界的重要反日匪徒。如果反日分子变得活跃，日本当局将发现有必要采取新措施。

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper)
publishes the following comment :-

THE CHINESE RATEPAYERS' ASSOCIATION

The Chinese Ratepayers' Association in the
International Settlement has a comparatively long history
and is held in high esteem by local residents. The
Association, however, is not in a position to carry out
the mission or to struggle for the interests of the
Chinese ratepayers for it is under strong oppression
at the hands of the foreigners.
In the International Settlement, foreigners
are in a favourable position everywhere, while Chinese
are frequently subjected to insult. The haughty
bearing of the foreigners is increasing and the Chinese
residents cannot secure redress for their grievances.
The reason is that prior to the hostilities, the
Kuomintang Government used to flatter the foreigners
and had failed to give support to the Chinese Ratepayers'
Association. The Chinese residents in the Settlement
have become short-sighted since the hostilities and
have been relying upon the foreigners. Up to the
present, the foreigners who are in possession of power
in the Settlement look upon the Chinese residents in
the Settlement as obedient people of their colonies and
treat them as slaves. Owing to this, the burden of the
Chinese people has increased for the foreigners are
making one demand after another. Not only is the
Chinese Ratepayers' Association helpless in its struggle
for justice and for the protection of the interests of
the Chinese ratepayers, but the Association itself is
being utilized by foreigners to oppress the Chinese
residents. It is not the Ratepayers' Association that
should be blamed; it is the Chinese residents who are
to blame. If the Chinese residents in the Settlement
will unanimously support the powerful "Reformed Government"
and the Chinese Ratepayers' Association is placed under
the direction of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the
"Reformed Government" so that force can be met with force,
the foreigners will not dare to treat the Chinese so
shabbily and the Ratepayers' Association will receive
strong support.
pages.zh:
《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）发表如下评论：

华人纳税会

公共租界内的华人纳税会历史较为悠久，深受当地居民敬重。然而，该会处于外国人的强力压迫之下，无法履行其使命，亦无法为华人纳税人争取利益。
在公共租界内，外国人处处占据有利地位，而华人则屡遭侮辱。外国人的傲慢态度日益加剧，华人居民无法为其冤屈寻求补救。究其原因，在于战事爆发前，国民党政府一味讨好外国人，未能给予华人纳税会支持。战事爆发后，租界内的华人居民变得短视，转而依赖外国人。迄今为止，掌握租界权力的外国人将租界内的华人居民视为其殖民地的顺民，并像对待奴隶一样对待他们。因此，随着外国人不断提出各种要求，华人的负担日益加重。华人纳税会不仅在为正义和华人纳税人利益而进行的斗争中无能为力，而且该会本身正被外国人利用来压迫华人居民。这不应归咎于纳税会，而应归咎于华人居民。如果租界内的华人居民一致支持强大的“维新政府”，并将华人纳税会置于“维新政府”外交部的指导之下，以便以实力对抗实力，外国人就不敢如此恶劣地对待华人，纳税会也将获得强有力的支持。

March 31, 1939.
Morning Translation

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper)
publishes the following editorial :-

THE QUESTION OF THE HOISTING OF FLAGS

"Blue Sky and the White Sun" flags
were displayed in large numbers in the International
Settlement and the French Concession on March 27, the
anniversary of the execution of 72 martyrs. The number
of flags hoisted on that day exceeded that exhibited
prior to the conclusion of the pact between the
Japanese and the authorities of the two Foreign
Settlements. On March 12, the authorities of the Foreign
Settlements took some action to prohibit the hoisting
of such flags in the districts within their jurisdiction.
The fact that the authorities did not enforce strict
measures to prohibit the hoisting of such flags is a
matter much to be deplored.
Mayor Fu Siao-en of the Shanghai City
Government has submitted several demands to the
authorities and the Consular Body and lately he has made
further representations to the authorities pressing for
an early reply to his demands. We hope that the
authorities of the Settlement will give proper considera-
tion to the reasonable demands of the Mayor.
It is worth while to recall here the
existence of the Shanghai Branch of the Kuomintang in
the Settlement. The Branch is indulging in all kinds
of activities that are a menace to peace and order.
Of late, the Tangpu has become especially active in
connection with the national spiritual mobilization.
It was undoubtedly at the strong insistence of the
Tangpu that so many Kuomintang flags were hoisted on the
present occasion. Therefore, the authorities of the
Foreign Settlements should take strong action against
the Tangpu/
All this has a strong significance and
should be settled, otherwise it may have serious
consequences. It deserves the special attention of
the two municipal authorities and should not be
regarded as a trivial event.
The "Blue Sky and White Sun" flag
signifies the sovietization of China; the flag has
also an anti-foreign significance. This surmise is
not at all groundless for the Kuomintang anthem contains
the following sentences: "Down with the Powers, Down
with the Powers." Is not this sufficient to show that
the flag has a strong anti-foreign significance? The
authorities of the Foreign Settlements are certainly
aware of all this. Therefore, it will be better to
suppress the hoisting of this flag.
To-day, the five-barred flag is being
used in nearly every part of China. Internally, this
flag means harmony among the various tribes of the
Chinese people, while externally, it means international
co-operation and utopia. The policy of the new
government in China is based on this principle.

1939年3月31日。
晨间译文

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）发表如下社论：

关于悬挂旗帜的问题

3月27日是七十二烈士殉难纪念日，当天公共租界和法租界内大量展示“青天白日”旗。当日悬挂的旗帜数量超过了日本当局与两个外国租界当局达成协定之前所展示的数量。3月12日，外国租界当局采取了一些行动，禁止在其管辖区域内悬挂此类旗帜。当局未采取严厉措施禁止悬挂此类旗帜，此事令人深感遗憾。
上海市政府市长傅筱庵已向当局及领事团提出多项要求，最近他又向当局进一步交涉，敦促对其要求尽早予以答复。我们希望租界当局能适当考虑市长的合理要求。
在此值得回顾一下国民党组织在租界内的存在情况。该分部从事各种危害和平与秩序的活动。近来，党部在国民精神总动员方面表现得尤为活跃。毫无疑问，正是在党部的强烈坚持下，此次才悬挂了如此多的国民党旗帜。因此，外国租界当局应对党部采取强硬行动/
这一切具有重大意义，应予解决，否则可能会产生严重后果。这值得两个市政当局特别注意，不应将其视为微不足道的事件。
“青天白日”旗象征着中国的苏维埃化；该旗也具有反外意义。这种推测并非毫无根据，因为国民党党歌中包含以下词句：“打倒列强，打倒列强。”这难道不足以表明该旗具有强烈的反外意义吗？外国租界当局当然清楚这一切。因此，最好禁止悬挂此旗。
如今，五色旗在中国几乎各地都在使用。对内，这面旗帜意味着中国各族人民的和谐；对外，则意味着国际合作与大同世界。中国新政府的政策正是基于这一原则。

March 30, 1939. Afternoon Translation.

Sin Shun Leo (Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper)
publishes the following editorial :-

HOIST THE ANTI-BRITISH MOVEMENT FLAG

It will not be difficult for Japan to
crush the remaining influence of the Kuomintang Army in
the present hostilities. The Kuomintang Army is in a
most embarrassing position. It is due to the assistance
rendered by Britain to Chiang Kai-shek that the war
calamities have been prolonged. If Britain had not
instigated the Kuomintang to resist or if she had not
rendered assistance to China after the outbreak of
hostilities, the war would have been over long ago.
Thus, Britain is responsible for the war and for its
prolongation. She is now obstructing the creation of
the new order in East Asia. We must wipe out Britain's
poisonous policy and oppose Britain so as to save China.
The people of China and Japan are peace-
loving. All British help must be rejected. By
opposing Britain's poisonous policy of invasion of the
Far East, the consolidation of peace in East Asia can
be affected. We should hoist the anti-British movement
flag as soon as possible in order to bring an early peace
to East Asia.

FILE

China has been at the mercy of treaties
since the Opium War. She has since become a market
for European and American goods. Britain has the
strongest influence in China and China has suffered
heavily at the hands of the British people. For the
sake of peace in East Asia, the Chinese people should
oppose Britain with undaunted spirit. For the sake
of the emancipation of China, the Chinese people should
oppose Britain to the bitter end.

An anti-British movement will save China.
Every Chinese should distinguish friend from foe and
should wipe out the poisonous account with Britain.
The Chinese people should, without hesitation, hoist
the anti-British movement flag.

Chinese in Central and South China have
already started an anti-British movement. The movement
is going on strongly in Nanking, the seat of the
"Reformed Government".

We should encourage the people to walk along
the anti-British path and raise the anti-British movement
flag.

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）发表如下社论：

升起反英运动旗帜

日本在目前的战事中粉碎国民党军队的残余影响并非难事。国民党军队正处于极为尴尬的境地。战争灾难之所以延长，是由于英国对蒋介石提供了援助。如果英国没有煽动国民党进行抵抗，或者在战事爆发后没有向中国提供援助，战争早就结束了。因此，英国对战争及其延长负有责任。她目前正在阻碍东亚新秩序的建立。我们必须清除英国的毒辣政策，反对英国，以拯救中国。
中日两国人民都是爱好和平的。必须拒绝一切英国的帮助。通过反对英国侵略远东的毒辣政策，可以巩固东亚的和平。我们应该尽快升起反英运动旗帜，以便使东亚早日实现和平。

档案

自鸦片战争以来，中国一直受制于条约。此后，中国成为了欧美商品的市场。英国在中国拥有最强的影响力，中国人民在英国人手中遭受了沉重苦难。为了东亚的和平，中国人民应以大无畏的精神反对英国。为了中国的解放，中国人民应坚决反对英国到底。

反英运动将拯救中国。每个中国人都应分清敌友，并与英国算清这笔毒辣的账。中国人民应毫不犹豫地升起反英运动旗帜。

华中和华南的中国人已经开始了反英运动。在“维新政府”所在地南京，这场运动正猛烈进行。

我们应该鼓励人民走上反英道路，举起反英运动旗帜。

pages.en:
Sin Shun Pao (Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper):
LIST OF MARTYRED HEROES OF "REFORMED GOVERNMENT"

Since the inauguration of the Chinese Republic,
the "Reformed Government" has been the only government
formed in accordance with the wishes of the Chinese
people. Thanks to the undaunted spirit of the
officials, a sound foundation has been laid for the
"Reformed Government". This new government has excited
the envy of the Chiang Kai-shek regime. This traitor
recently detailed his followers to the Foreign Settlements
to carry out assassinations.
It is true that hearty celebrations should
be held on the occasion of the first anniversary of the
inauguration of the "Reformed Government" but appropriate
measures should also be drawn up to recall the activities
of the martyrs who have sacrificed their lives for the
country.
The following is a list of names of the
martyrs to whom people throughout the country should pay
their respects:-
Chen Loh (陳籙), late Minister of Foreign Affairs,
Yu Ta-yung (余大雄), late Councillor to the
Ministry of Industry and concurrently manager of the
United Press of China (中華聯合通訊社),
Ho Tsai (何讚), late Mayor of Hangchow,

Moh Yoch-han (馬育航), late advisor to the
Legislative Yuan,
Tu Foh (屠復 ), late President of the Nantao
District Court,
Wong Cheh-jen (王傑人), late Chief of the Boat
Control Office of the Shanghai City Government,
Chow Feng-chi (周鳳岐), Chen Yuin (陳云),
Chang Zang-nyi (莊尚義 Siao Chang 小庄), Chien Hwa
(錢華), Li Dio-chieh (李國杰), Loh Pah-hung (陸伯鴻),
Loh Lian-kwei (陸連奎) and 827 others.
pages.zh:
《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）：
“维新政府”殉难英雄名录

自中华民国成立以来，“维新政府”是唯一一个按照中国人民意愿组成的政府。得益于官员们的大无畏精神，“维新政府”已奠定了坚实的基础。这个新政府引起了蒋介石政权的嫉妒。这名叛徒最近派遣其追随者前往外国租界实施暗杀。
诚然，在“维新政府”成立一周年之际应举行热烈的庆祝活动，但也应制定适当的措施，以纪念为国捐躯的烈士们的活动。
以下是全国各地人民应致以敬意的烈士名单：
陈籙，前外交部长，
余大雄，前实业部顾问兼中华联合通讯社经理，
何讚，前杭州市长，

马育航，前立法院顾问，
屠復 ，前南市地方法院院长，
王傑人，前上海市政府船务管理处主任，
周鳳岐，陳云，
莊尚義（小庄），錢華，李國杰，陸伯鴻，
陸連奎及其他827人。
