March 29, 1939.                                      Afternoon Translation.

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper)
publishes the following article :-

BRITISH AGGRESSION IN CHINA

        Cases of       British aggression in China
are so numerous that it is impossible to outline them all.
British aggression in China is simply a part of Great
Britain's policy towards China.
        In order to be in a position to establish
a New China, we must have an understanding of the
following points relating to Britain :-
1) We must formulate a definite policy to deal with
England.
2) We must endeavour to establish a new order in East
Asia and organize an International League of Nations
of East Asia.
3) We must expand the anti-British propaganda and sever
economic relations with Britain, the bitterest enemy
of China.    If the Chinese people will come to their
senses and cease to buy British goods, refuse to
use British ships or to deposit their savings in
British banks and stop all commercial connections
with the British people, Britain will not be in a
position to carry out her economic aggression in China.
        Let us shout the following slogans :-
(1) Let all nations in East Asia unite!
(2) Abolish the unequal treaties between China and Britain!
(3) Recover the British Concessions and abolish consular
jurisdiction!
(4) Down with outrageous British Imperialists!
(5) Long live the emancipation of New China!
(6) Long live the emancipation of the new East Asia!
pages.zh:
1939年3月29日。                                      下午译文。

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）发表如下文章：

英国在华侵略

英国在华侵略案件数不胜数，无法一一列举。英国在华侵略 simply 是英国对华政策的一部分。
为了有能力建立一个新中国，我们必须了解有关英国的以下几点：
1) 我们必须制定明确的政策来对付英国。
2) 我们必须努力建立东亚新秩序，并组织东亚国际联盟。
3) 我们必须扩大反英宣传，并与中国最凶恶的敌人英国断绝经济关系。如果中国人民觉醒，停止购买英国货，拒绝使用英国船只或不在英国银行存款，并停止与英国人的一切商业往来，英国将无法在中国实行其经济侵略。
让我们高呼以下口号：
(1) 东亚各国联合起来！
(2) 废除中英不平等条约！
(3) 收回英租界并废除领事裁判权！
(4) 打倒猖獗的英国帝国主义者！
(5) 新中国解放万岁！
(6) 新东亚解放万岁！

pages.en:
Sin Shun Pao (Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper)
publishes the following article written by one Hou Ping(侯兵):-

THE POLICY OF MALTREATING AND KILLING CHINESE PEOPLE
IN THE BRITISH CONCESSION

For a long time already, Britain had wished
to annex China. It is impossible to expose all the
cruel and inhuman acts committed by the British people
in China in the past. Readers who desire more details
should read the book entitled "History of the Invasions
of China by the British Imperialists."
What I want to say to-day is that after the
withdrawal of the Kuomintang Army from Shanghai, the
British people began to maltreat and kill the Chinese
people. This is a very serious question.
On the fall of Shanghai, Chinese refugees
hurriedly sought shelter in the Foreign Settlements,
including the British Concession. Pretending to be
merciful, the foreigners did their best to accommodate
the refugees with the object of making profit. Before
the hostilities, the population in the Foreign Settlements
of Shanghai was approximately 3,000,000. To-day it has
pages.zh:
《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）发表侯兵撰写的一篇文章：

英租界虐待和杀害中国人的政策

长期以来，英国一直企图吞并中国。过去英国人在中国犯下的所有残酷和不人道行为不可能全部揭露。希望了解更多详情的读者，请阅读题为《英国帝国主义侵华史》一书。
我今天想说的是，在国民党军队撤离上海后，英国人开始虐待和杀害中国人。这是一个非常严重的问题。
上海沦陷时，中国难民匆忙涌入包括英租界在内的外国租界寻求庇护。外国人假装仁慈，尽力安置难民，目的是牟利。战事爆发前，上海外国租界的人口约为300万。今天它已

pages.en:
March 29, 1939. Afternoon Translation.

increased fourfold. Can the small area of the Foreign
Settlements accommodate such a vast population? So
long as they can make profit, they pay no attention to
anything else!
House rent has been increased again and
again, lofts have been erected in houses, electricity
and water charges have been increased repeatedly. The
Settlements are overcrowded and all kinds of evil practices
are taking place. Kidnappers are very active, robbers
kill people and commit other crimes, while loafers commit
murder in order to get money. Foreigners, capitalists,
shop-keepers, philanthropists and educationists--- all
are committing man-eating and man-killing acts.
Gonorrhea, syphilis, cholera and all kinds of infectious
diseases are prevalent everywhere with the result that
over 1,000 Chinese people die everyday. Humanity and
law are unknown. To-day, Shanghai, which had always
been known as the Paris of the Far East, has become a
hell on earth.
The above reveals the plots of the Foreign
Settlements to harm the Chinese people. Of late, the
British Concession has been carrying out a policy of
maltreating and killing Chinese people. The authorities
of the British Concession are treating Chinese residents
more cruelly. Take for instance, the question of the
construction of lofts. The erection of lofts is regarded
by the community as harmful to public health. Its
construction was and is still prohibited by the Public
Health Department. However, despite the prohibition,
lofts are being constructed in nearly every house. At
present an ordinary two-story dwelling house is occupied
by 60 to 100 persons and alterations to windows and doors
have kept the sun away and dampness sets in. In the
event of death through illness of one of the inmates or
in case of an epidemic, many people would be affected.
The S.M.C. is not unaware of such a state
of affairs. A certain interpreter of the Public Health
Department discovered that a chief tenant always entrusts
an influential person to bribe the Department to permit
the erection of a loft in his house. We have often
witnessed sub-tenants being harshly pressed by chief
tenants, while complaints lodged by sub-tenants against
unlawful acts committed by chief tenants are ignored
by the authorities. If a tenant fails to offer a
bribe beforehand, a fine of even $1,500 may be imposed
on him for a slight contravention of the regulations or
for insensitization. For the sake of money, the S.M.C.
regards the lives of the Chinese residents as of little
value. It is only on the outbreak of an epidemic
disease when they fear that the lives of
foreigners may be endangered that Red Cross ambulances
are mobilized and despatched to various streets where
pedestrians are forced to undergo free injections.
There are certain stupid Chinese who worship
the foreigners for their mercy.
The British are not blind to the fact that
unemployed Chinese in the Settlement are urgently needed
in the interior to work at productive industries and that
pages.zh:
1939年3月29日。下午译文。

增加了四倍。外租界那狭小的区域能容纳如此庞大的人口吗？只要能获利，他们便对其他一切置若罔闻！
房租一涨再涨，房屋内搭建阁楼，水电费反复增加。租界内人满为患，各种恶行层出不穷。绑匪活动猖獗，强盗杀人并犯下其他罪行，而游手好闲之徒为谋财而杀人。外国人、资本家、店主、慈善家和教育家——全都在进行吃人杀人的勾当。
淋病、梅毒、霍乱及各种传染病到处流行，导致每天有一千多中国人死亡。人道与法律荡然无存。今日，上海这座向来被称为“远东巴黎”的城市，已变成人间地狱。
上述情况揭示了外租界损害中国人的阴谋。近来，英租界一直推行虐待和杀害中国人的政策。英租界当局对待中国居民更加残酷。以搭建阁楼的问题为例。社区认为搭建阁楼有害公共卫生。工部局卫生处过去和现在都禁止搭建阁楼。然而，尽管有禁令，几乎每户人家都在搭建阁楼。目前，一栋普通的两层住宅居住着60至100人，门窗的改动遮挡了阳光，导致湿气滋生。如果住户中有人因病死亡或发生疫情，许多人将受到波及。
工部局并非不了解这种状况。卫生处的一名译员发现，某二房东总是委托一位有影响力的人贿赂卫生处，以获准在其房屋内搭建阁楼。我们经常目睹二房东严厉压迫分租客，而分租客针对二房东违法行为提出的投诉却被当局无视。如果租户事先不行贿，即使轻微违反规定或表现出不敏感（insensitization），也可能被处以高达1,500美元的罚款。为了金钱，工部局视中国居民的生命如草芥。只有在爆发流行病、担心外国人生命受到威胁时，才会动员红十字会救护车派往各条街道，强迫行人接受免费注射。
有些愚蠢的中国人崇拜外国人的仁慈。
英国人并非不知道，租界内的失业中国人急需前往内地从事生产性行业，而且

pages.en:
March 29, 1939.
Afternoon Translation.

their removal is logical and practicable. If they will
not do so for the sake of China, they should do so at least
in the interests of peace and good order in the Concession.
Nevertheless, by means of Press propaganda, they instigate
China to plunder their own fellow-countrymen and in turn
they exploit and oppress them to death. Is not the
British Concession energetically maltreating the Chinese
people?
It is the traditional policy of Great Britain
to "use Chinese to fight Chinese" and "yellow people to
fight yellow people". The Chiang regime is one of the
puppets that is being utilized by them.
The establishing of a new order in the Orient
will be a fatal blow to Britain. As her puppet the
Chiang regime has now been defeated, not only will Britain's
dream of full control over the Far East be shattered
but even her existing interests in the East will be lost
to her. Considerable success has been achieved by
Britain during the past few years in her anti-Japanese
and anti-Reformed Government movement. Freedom of
speech is allowed to the Kuomintang authorities in the
Concession and they hand out ridiculous articles to
defraud the people. Not one criminal has so far been
arrested in the more than ten terroristic incidents
which occurred in a single month.
Pressed by the strong protests lodged by
the Japanese Government and the "Reformed Government",
they are adopting an elusive policy, such as putting up
barbed wire entanglements, searching of pedestrians and
hotels, in an endeavour to divert the attention of the
various Powers.
In reality, the women's corps and the boy
scouts of the New Fourth Army have been secretly invited
and are undertaking well-planned activities on a big scale.
As soon as the people are living in peace, the British
will instigate men to throw hand grenades and disseminate
handbills. For instance, to-day (March 21), Wang Chen-
zung (王振宗), Chief of the Boat Control Office of the
Communications Bureau of the Shanghai City Government,
was murdered in the Wei Chung Hotel on Hankow Road, and
the Japanese proprietor of the Mukai Silk Embroidery
Store on Bubbling Well Road was stabbed. The policemen
and detectives pretended to be deaf and dumb and allowed
the criminals to make good their escape. Can it not
be said that the authorities of the British Concession
are killing Chinese and Japanese?
As the British Concession is directly or
indirectly responsible for the assassination of Chinese
and Japanese, can we look on calmly? Have we any plan
to deal with the situation? The British Concession
and the British people to-day care nothing for justice
or humanity or peace. The only measure that we should
take is to keep a watch on the plottings. So long as
the British Concession is not recovered and so long as
the British people are not expelled, the people of China
and Japan will suffer. We should not stop till our
object has been attained.
pages.zh:
1939年3月29日。
下午译文。

将他们迁出是合乎逻辑且切实可行的。如果他们不是为了中国的利益这样做，至少也应为了租界的和平与良好秩序而这样做。然而，他们通过新闻宣传，煽动中国人掠夺自己的同胞，进而剥削和压迫他们至死。这难道不是英租界在积极虐待中国人民吗？
英国的传统政策是“以华制华”和“以黄制黄”。蒋介石政权是他们利用的傀儡之一。
在东方建立新秩序将对英国造成致命打击。作为其傀儡的蒋介石政权现已战败，不仅英国完全控制远东的梦想将破灭，甚至其在东方的现有利益也将丧失。在过去几年里，英国在反日和反对维新政府运动中取得了相当大的成功。国民党当局在租界内被允许享有言论自由，他们散布荒谬的文章来欺骗民众。在一个月内发生的十多起恐怖事件中，至今没有一名罪犯被捕。
在日本政府和“维新政府”提出的强烈抗议压力下，他们采取了一种含糊其辞的政策，例如设置铁丝网障碍、搜查行人和旅馆，试图转移各国的注意力。
实际上，新四军的女兵队和童子军已被秘密邀请，并正在大规模地开展精心策划的活动。一旦人们过上和平生活，英国人就会煽动他人投掷手榴弹并散发传单。例如，今天（3月21日），上海市政府交通局船务管理处处长王振宗在汉口路的伟中饭店（Wei Chung Hotel）被谋杀，静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）向井丝绸刺绣店（Mukai Silk Embroidery Store）的日本店主被刺伤。警察和侦探装聋作哑，任由罪犯逃脱。这难道不能说英租界当局是在杀害中国人和日本人吗？
既然英租界对中国人和日本人的暗杀负有直接或间接责任，我们怎能袖手旁观？我们有任何应对局势的计划吗？如今的英租界和英国人根本不在乎正义、人道或和平。我们应采取的唯一措施是监视其阴谋。只要不收回英租界，只要不驱逐英国人，中日两国人民就将受苦。在达到我们的目标之前，我们不应停止。

pages.en:
March 24, 1939.
Afternoon Translation

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper)
publishes the following article written by one signing
himself "Bugler":

BRITAIN IS THE FIRST ENEMY OF CHINA

Britain is known for her vicious diplomacy.
In Europe, she is known for her wickedness, while in the
Asiatic Continent she is regarded as the most cunning
and crafty nation in the world. Many lives in Europe
and Asia have been sacrificed due to the wicked intrigues
of Britain. Fortunately, the world does not lack
sensible and broad-minded people, otherwise Britain
could easily camouflage her vicious activities. The
oppressive activities of Great Britain are only too well
known to the Chinese people. Take, for instance, our
fellow countrymen residing under the iron heels of the
British Imperialists in Singapore, Hongkong, Burma and
other British colonies. They have to lead the life of
slaves due to the shameless lack of power on the part of
the Chiang Kai-shek government.
The Chinese are indeed an unfortunate
people. They are being subjected to oppression by the
militarists of the Chiang Kai-shek regime within and to
exploitation by the European and American Powers without.
It was due to instigation on the part of these Powers
that the present disastrous bloodshed has been brought
about between China and Japan. Lacking the assistance
of military supplies to the Kuomintang government by the
European and American nations, the hostilities would not
have assumed such an extensive scale, and the Chiang Kai-
shek government would not have been regenerated. In
the eyes of the British government, so long as the
Sino-Japanese hostilities are advantageous, there is no
need to consider right and humanity.
In Shanghai alone, the amount of money
that has been made by the British people since the
outbreak of the hostilities is beyond estimation, and
yet the Chinese language newspapers in the Foreign
Settlements have published articles in block letters
favourable to Britain. Therefore, it is only natural
for the British people to look down the Chinese with
contempt. In order to bring about the suppression of
anti-Japanese feelings and anti-peace movements prevailing
in the Foreign Settlements, all such cultural organs
that indulge in anti-Japanese propaganda should be the
first to be suppressed. It is to be hoped that this
suggestion will be given favourable consideration by the
Japanese authorities and the "Reformed Government".
In the eyes of the general public, the
Sino-Japanese hostilities will not end soon. But this
is a mistaken idea. In my opinion, so long as the
Chinese people come to their senses and refuse to
compromise or co-operate with their only enemy, the
British Imperialists, we will be able to achieve victory.
All the Chinese people should unite to shake off the
yoke that is placed upon their shoulders by the enemy.
To-day is the date for us to liquidate all our past
pages.zh:
1939年3月24日。
下午译文

《新顺报》（Sin Shun Pao，日资中文报纸）刊登了一篇署名为“号手”的文章：

英国是中国的第一敌人

英国以其邪恶的外交而闻名。在欧洲，它以恶毒著称；而在亚洲大陆，它被视为世界上最狡猾和奸诈的国家。由于英国的邪恶阴谋，欧洲和亚洲许多生命牺牲。幸运的是，世界上并不缺乏理智和心胸宽广的人，否则英国很容易掩盖其恶行。中国人民对英国的压迫活动知之甚详。例如，我们的同胞居住在新加坡、香港、缅甸和其他英国殖民地的英国帝国主义者的铁蹄之下。由于蒋介石政府无耻地无力保护，他们不得不过着奴隶般的生活。
中国人确实是不幸的人民。他们在国内受到蒋介石政权军阀的压迫，在国外受到欧美列强的剥削。正是由于这些列强的煽动，才导致了当前中日之间灾难性的流血冲突。如果没有欧美国家对国民党政府的军事物资援助，敌对行动不会扩大到如此规模，蒋介石政权也不会得以延续。在英国政府眼中，只要中日敌对行动有利可图，就无需考虑正义和人道。
仅在上海，自敌对行动爆发以来，英国人赚取的金钱数额无法估量，然而外租界的中文报纸却刊登了大块标题的亲英文章。因此，英国人轻视中国人也是自然而然的。为了压制外租界盛行的反日情绪和反和平运动，所有 indulge in 反日宣传的文化机构应首先予以取缔。希望日本当局和“维新政府”能对此建议给予有利考虑。
在公众眼中，中日敌对行动不会很快结束。但这是一个错误的想法。在我看来，只要中国人民清醒过来，拒绝与他们唯一的敌人——英国帝国主义者——妥协或合作，我们就能够取得胜利。全体中国人民应团结起来，摆脱敌人强加在他们肩上的枷锁。今天是我们清算过去所有

"COUNTERFEIT NOTES IN CIRCULATION ON THE MARKET :
CITIZENS SHOULD BEWARE"

With the arrival of large numbers of refugees
from other places, the Foreign Settlements of Shanghai
have become very prosperous. As a result of slackness
on the part of the Police, murders and shooting outrages
have taken place repeatedly, and in addition, counterfeit
banknotes have appeared on the market with the result
that many country folks have suffered heavily.
Yesterday, a woman in a tram car used a
$1 note to pay her fare. As the car was very crowded
at the time, she was not immediately given her change.
As she was about to leave the car at her destination,
the conductor handed her the change.
After she had alighted, she found a
counterfeit 50-cent note in the change.
pages.zh:
《新顺报》（Sin Shun Pao，日资中文报纸）称：
“市场上流通假钞：市民应警惕”

随着大量外地难民的涌入，上海外租界变得非常繁荣。由于警方松懈，谋杀和枪击暴行屡有发生，此外，市场上出现了假钞，导致许多乡下人遭受重大损失。
昨天，一名妇女在有轨电车上用一张1元纸币支付车费。当时车厢非常拥挤，她没有立即收到找零。当她到达目的地准备下车时，售票员将找零递给了她。
下车后，她发现找零中有一张50分的假钞。

September 15, 1938.
Afternoon Translation.

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper):

CONDITIONS IN HANKOW

According to information received from certain
foreign organs at Hankow, the reports of the withdrawal
of Government troops from the fronts on the north and
south banks of the Yangtze have caused much uneasiness
to the inhabitants of the Wuhan.
Recently, the defence authorities of Wuhan
announced that travelling expenses would be issued to
refugees who were without funds, but when people applied
for funds, many were turned away and this has caused much
dissatisfaction with the Kuomintang Government. Public
officers and their families from war affected areas
who came to seek refuge in the Wuhan have received no
relief whatever from the authorities.
Despite a 40% reduction of their pay, the
employees of official organs in the Wuhan have to buy
National Salvation Bonds and are forced to offer gold to
the Government. Thus their income has been heavily reduced
with the result that they are finding it difficult to
maintain their living. Most of them have taken up work
at other places and some are accepting bribes to maintain
their living.
At the beginning of this month, certain
undesirable elements supported by these public officers
delivered strong speeches before an audience of several
thousand citizens on Chung Shan Road at Hankow. They
declared that without any consideration for the livelihood
of the people, Chiang Kai-shek had started a war of
resistance against Japan, thereby bringing destruction of
life and property to the people. The crowd was suddenly
surrounded by the defence force and some 100 of them were
placed under arrest. 14 of the arrested persons, said
to be the ringleaders, were executed on the spot.
It is learned that in view of this incident,
the defence authorities of Wuhan have decided to conduct a
search for undesirable elements.

1938年9月15日。
下午译文。

《新申报》（日资中文报纸）：

汉口局势

据从汉口某些外国机构获得的消息，关于政府军队从长江南北两岸前线撤退的报道，已引起武汉居民的极大不安。
近日，武汉防卫当局宣布将向无资金的难民发放旅费，但当人们申请资金时，许多人被拒之门外，这引起了人们对国民党政府的强烈不满。来自战区的公职人员及其家属来武汉避难，未从当局得到任何救济。
尽管薪水减少了40%，武汉各官方机构的雇员仍须购买救国公债，并被迫向政府捐献黄金。因此，他们的收入大幅减少，导致难以维持生计。他们中大多数人已在其他地方谋职，有些人则通过收受贿赂来维持生活。
本月初，在这些公职人员支持下的某些不良分子，在汉口中山路面向数千名市民发表了激烈演讲。他们宣称，蒋介石不顾人民生计，发动了对日抗战，从而给人民带来了生命和财产的毁灭。人群突然被防卫部队包围，其中约100人被捕。据说被捕者中的14名首犯被就地正法。
据悉，鉴于此事件，武汉防卫当局决定对不良分子进行搜查。

THE CASE OF WONG SI-ZUNG

During the past few years, Wong Si-zung
(王雨神), former Principal of Tseng Feng College (曾風學院)
and secretary to the "Sin Wan Pao", has been in poor
circumstances. His condition became worse after the
outbreak of hostilities in Shanghai.
At the instigation of a certain party,
Wong Si-zung lost his character and became an editor of
the "Sin Shun Pao" (a Japanese owned Chinese language
newspaper). Since then, his friends have severed all
connection with him. The teachers and students of
Tseng Feng College became angry at Wong's act and left
the school.
At the beginning of this month, the
directors of Tseng Feng College held a meeting, at which
Chiang Vee-jao (蔣維喬) of the Kiangsu Educational
Association was elected Principal of the college.

在过去几年里，曾风学院前院长、《新闻报》秘书王雨神（Wong Si-zung）境况不佳。上海战事爆发后，他的处境更加恶化。
在某一方唆使下，王雨神丧失气节，成为《新申报》（一家日资中文报纸）的编辑。自此，他的朋友与他断绝了一切往来。曾风学院的师生对王的行为感到愤怒，离开了学校。

August 10, 1938.
Afternoon Translation

Sin Shun Lao (Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper) :-

MOVEMENT FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF A NEW CHINA

Nearly a year has elapsed since hostilities broke out in Shanghai. Most of the people have suffered through the military operations and many have been rendered homeless and destitute. Such a meaningless war is not only increasing the hardships of the people, but is also hastening China's downfall. As a protest against the wrong policy adopted by the Kuomintang in co-operating with Soviet Russia to resist Japan, a section of the intelligent class of people has organized a powerful association known as the "Ta Min Association" ("Great People's Association" 大民会). With a view to saving China from her present critical situation, this Association will lead the people in Shanghai to hold a meeting to celebrate the movement for the construction of a New China on the anniversary of the outbreak of hostilities on August 13.

The Association has put forward the following queries and leaves it to the readers to choose the answers :-
Question: (1) Why is China putting up a fight against Japan, thereby resulting in the present calamity?
Answers : (a) China is fighting Japan in order to strengthen the country and enrich the people.
(b) Chiang Kai-shek is entirely responsible for China's war with Japan for the purpose of safeguarding his own position
(c) China is fighting Japan entirely at the instigation of Britain, Russia and other Powers.

Question: (2) Is it not a fact that the Kuomintang, which is dominated by Chiang (蒋) and Soong (宋), is using an anti-Japanese policy as a means to exploit the people?
Answers: (a) Chiang, Soong, Kung and other high officials of the National Government have contributed their entire private property to finance the war of resistance.
(b) The present war against Japan is merely increasing the people's burden.
(c) In the present war the private property of the high officials of the National Government has been increased.

Question: (3) Why does Soviet Russia assist the National Government?
Answers: (a) In rendering assistance, Soviet Russia intends to sovietize the whole of China.
(b) She wants to jeopardize the peace in the Orient.
(c) She is assisting in developing the influence of the Chinese Communist Party.

1938年8月10日。
下午译文

《新申报》（日资中文报纸）：-

建设新中国运动

上海战事爆发已近一年。大多数民众饱受军事行动之苦，许多人无家可归，陷入贫困。这场毫无意义的战争不仅增加了人民的苦难，也加速了中国的衰亡。为抗议国民党采取与苏联合作抗日的错误政策，部分知识阶层组织了一个强大的协会，名为“大民会”。为了将中国从目前的危急局势中拯救出来，该协会将领导上海民众在8月13日战事爆发周年纪念日举行集会，庆祝建设新中国运动。

该协会提出了以下问题，并由读者选择答案：-
问题：(1) 中国为何对日作战，从而导致目前的灾难？
答案：(a) 中国对日作战是为了强国富民。
(b) 蒋介石为了维护自己的地位，完全应对中国对日战争负责。
(c) 中国对日作战完全是受英国、俄国及其他列强唆使。

问题：(2) 由蒋（Chiang）和宋（Soong）主导的国民党利用反日政策作为剥削人民的手段，这难道不是事实吗？
答案：(a) 蒋、宋、孔等国民政府高官已捐出全部私产以资助抗战。
(b) 目前的对日战争仅仅增加了人民的负担。
(c) 在目前的战争中，国民政府高官的私产有所增加。

问题：(3) 苏联为何援助国民政府？
答案：(a) 苏联提供援助意在使整个中国苏维埃化。
(b) 她希望破坏东方的和平。
(c) 她正在协助发展中国共产党的影响力。

问题：(4) 由国民党指挥的流动部队是人民的朋友还是敌人？
答案：(a) 他们是人民的朋友。
(b) 他们是人民的敌人，因为他们制造的骚乱使人民陷入无助。

问题：(5) 国民政府财政部的高官是否正在将中国的财富输送到国外，这是真的吗？

pages.en:
August 10, 1938.
Morning Translation.

Ta Mei Pao and other local newspapers s-

REPORTER OF "SIN SHUN PAO" ARRESTED ON CHARGE OF EXTORTION

Sung Chi-li (沈千里), age 31, native of Kiangsi, was formerly the proprietor of the Chung Hwa News Agency (中華南訊社) in Shanghai and an editor of the "Modern Daily News" (時代日報), a mosquito paper, which went out of business sometime ago. Recently, he became acquainted with a Japanese and on the latter's recommendation, he came to Shanghai at the beginning of this month and joined the "Sin Shun Pao" (新申報), a Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper, as a reporter.

At 9.20 p.m. August 8, Sung called at No.300, 3rd floor, Nanking Road, and desired to interview lawyer Chi Chung-zai (李忠隨) alias Chi Yang-chow (李仰周), age 39, native of Chwansha, who has been in practice for a period of 9 years. As the lawyer was absent, Sung introduced himself to the lawyer's niece Koo Ping-fong (顧品芳) as "Wong Zay-eur"(王瑞源) and made the following statement to her :- "A certain man named Sze (施), living at No. 34 Avenue Edward VII, sent a telephone message to the Japanese in my newspaper office to-day to report that lawyer Chi is a staff officer of the mobile units in Pootung. As the man could not speak Japanese, I received the call. In my opinion, it is probable that the man has a grudge against lawyer Chi. It is lucky that it was not a Japanese who received the telephone message direct, otherwise the life of lawyer Chi would be in danger."

It seemed that Sung was trying to settle the matter with the payment of some money.

The girl replied that she would inform the lawyer on his return and asked the caller to leave his address. Sung wrote down his name as "Wong Zay-eur" and gave his telephone number as 32126. He said that he would call again at 9 or 10 a.m. the following day.

Having been informed of the affair by the girl upon his return, lawyer Chi, who had never taken part in political affairs, reported the matter to Central Police Station. D.S.I. Guess and C.D.S. Liu Teh-chen (劉德成), after an investigation, came to the conclusion that Sung Chi-li was attempting to extort money by means of intimidation.

Pretending first they were from the Fire Brigade and then from the Telephone Company, the officers rang up 32126 and learned that the telephone was that of the Tien Kai Ziang Engineering Works (天開祥机器廠) No. 946 Avenue Road. At 11 a.m. on that day, the officers telephoned the Tien Kai Ziang Works and asked "Wong Zay-eur" to come to the phone. Sung Chi-li received the call and one of the officers, posing as lawyer Chi Chung-zai, told Sung that he would call at Sung's place at once to discuss the matter. The officers and lawyer Chi then took a motor car and went to Sung's place. The lawyer entered the house first and Sung came out to receive him. The detectives then arrested Sung and took him to the Police Station, where he made a confession.
pages.zh:
1938年8月10日。
上午译文。

《大美晚报》及其他本地报纸：-

《新申报》记者因涉嫌敲诈被捕

沈千里（Sung Chi-li），31岁，江西人，曾任上海中华南讯社社长及小型报纸《时代日报》编辑，该报已于不久前停业。最近，他结识了一名日本人，并在该日本人的推荐下，于本月初来到上海，加入日资中文报纸《新申报》担任记者。

8月8日晚9时20分，沈前往南京路300号三楼，希望采访律师李忠随（Chi Chung-zai），别名李仰周（Chi Yang-chow），39岁，川沙人，执业已有9年。因律师不在，沈向律师的侄女顾品芳（Koo Ping-fong）自我介绍为“王瑞源”（Wong Zay-eur），并对她作了如下陈述：“今天住在爱多亚路34号的一个姓施（Sze）的人，打电话到我报社的日本人间，报告说李律师是浦东流动部队的参谋。因为那人不会说日语，是我接的电话。在我看来，此人很可能与李律师有仇。幸好接电话的不是日本人，否则李律师的生命会有危险。”

沈似乎试图通过支付一些钱来了结此事。

女孩回答说，她会在律师回来后告知此事，并请来访者留下地址。沈写下名字为“王瑞源”，并给出电话号码32126。他说他将在第二天上午9点或10点再来。

律师李回来后，从女孩处得知此事。李从未参与政治事务，遂将此案报告给中央捕房。副巡官盖斯（Guess）和华探刘德成（Liu Teh-chen）经调查后得出结论，认为沈千里企图通过恐吓手段敲诈钱财。

警官们先是假装来自消防队，随后又假装来自电话公司，拨打了32126号码，获悉该电话属于爱文义路946号天开祥机器厂。当天上午11时，警官们致电天开祥工厂，请“王瑞源”接听电话。沈千里接了电话，其中一名警官冒充律师李忠随，告诉沈他将立即前往沈的住处商讨此事。随后，警官们和李律师乘汽车前往沈的住处。律师先进入屋内，沈出来接待。侦探随即逮捕了沈，并将其带往捕房，沈在那里供认不讳。

pages.en:
August 10, 1938. Morning Translation.

The case came up before the Shanghai First
Special District Court on the morning of August 9, when
the Assistant Municipal Advocate charged the accused
under Articles 305 and 346 of the Chinese Criminal Code
with restraint of personal liberty and intimidation and
extortion. The Municipal Advocate asked for a remand
in order to ascertain whether the accused was in the employ
of the "Sin Shun Pao" and whether there was a man named
Sze living at No. 34 Avenue Edward VII.
Questioned by the Court, the accused Sung
Chi-li confessed to having visited the office of lawyer
Chi, but denied that he had attempted extortion.
The girl Koo Ping-fong gave evidence that
Sung, when speaking, gave an impression that he desired
to settle the matter by a payment of money.
Judge Fang Sz-teh (方叔平) ordered the
accused to be detained and remanded the case for further
hearing.

The "Sin Shun Pao" (a Japanese owned Chinese
language newspaper) publishes an item to-day denying that
there is an employee in its office bearing the name of
Sung Chi-li.
pages.zh:
1938年8月10日。上午译文。

该案于8月9日上午在上海第一特区地方法院开庭，市助理检察官依据《中华民国刑法》第305条和第346条，指控被告非法拘禁、恐吓及敲诈勒索。市检察官要求还押候审，以便查明被告是否受雇于《新申报》，以及爱多亚路34号是否住有一名姓施的人。
经法庭讯问，被告沈千里承认曾拜访李律师办公室，但否认企图敲诈。
女孩顾品芳作证称，沈在谈话时给人的印象是希望通过付款来了结此事。
法官方叔平（Fang Sz-teh）下令羁押被告，并将案件发回进一步审理。

《新申报》（一家日资中文报纸）今日刊登一则消息，否认其办事处有一名名为沈千里的雇员。

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper)
published the following article on August 7 :-

THE ANNIVERSARY OF AUGUST 13 AND THE MOVEMENT FOR THE
REVIVAL OF A NEW CHINA

Nearly a year has elapsed since the outbreak
of hostilities on August 13 last year. Will the war of
resistance be carried on or will there be peace henceforth?
Shall we continue to adhere to the Kuomintang regime, thereby
making ourselves suffer still more, or shall we support
the "Reformed Government of the Chinese Republic" and the
Provisional Government in the acceleration of peace towards
the establishment of a New China? A movement is now afoot
amongst various local public bodies for the recognition of
August 13 as the date for the anniversary of the revival
of a New China. It is receiving wide support from various
bodies in Central China and is likely to develop into a people's
movement.

In connection with this movement, our reporter
secured on August 6 the following four kinds of handbills
from certain local bodies:-

(1) Why has China engaged in a war with Japan?
Is it for the welfare of the people? If this is the case,
then let us see what the conditions are that now face the
Chinese people? Is it for the rejuvenation of China? If
it is so, then what is the real outcome of this war of
resistance? Has Chinese territory been extended or otherwise?

(2) Nowhere has Chiang Kai-shek met with success,
yet he is still reluctant to give up his rights in lost
territory, and has compelled part of the remnants of his
soldiers to remain in these areas to create disturbances.

D.C.S.B.

《新申报》（日资中文报纸）于8月7日发表以下文章：-

八一三周年纪念与新中国复兴运动

自去年八一三战事爆发以来，已近一年。抗战将继续进行，还是从此迎来和平？我们是继续拥护国民党政权，从而使自己遭受更多苦难，还是支持“中华民国维新政府”和临时政府，加速实现和平以建立新中国？目前，各地公共团体中正兴起一项运动，主张将8月13日定为新中国复兴周年纪念日。该运动得到了华中各界团体的广泛支持，有可能发展成为一场民众运动。

关于这一运动，本报记者于8月6日从某些地方团体获取了以下四种传单：-

(1) 中国为何卷入对日战争？是为了人民的福祉吗？如果是这样，那么让我们看看中国人民目前面临的是什么状况？是为了中国的复兴吗？如果是这样，那么这场抗战的真正结果是什么？中国领土是否有所扩展或其他变化？

(2) 蒋介石处处碰壁，但他仍不愿放弃失地的主权，并迫使部分残部留在这些地区制造骚乱。

D.C.S.B.

However, he is not in a position to supply them with
arms and ammunition. Consequently, they have become
bandit-like and have committed all kinds of unlawful
activities, such as looting and abductions for ransom.
Take, for instance, Tao Sih-sung (陶雪生). This man
had absolutely not a single soldier under him and yet he
stayed inside the Foreign Settlements engaging in all kinds
of absurd propaganda with a view to realizing monetary
projects by means of treacherous activities. Take, for
another instance, the leader of the mobile units in Quinsan.
He has taken advantage of his position to commit all kinds
of nefarious activities, such as looting and kidnappings,
much to the detriment of the people.

(3) Ever since the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese
hostilities, the people have been made to bear several
increases in their burdens, such as aviation taxes, national
salvation taxes, etc. They are at present not even in a
position to maintain their own livelihood. Many of those
who formerly advocated war with Japan are now greatly
disappointed. But on the other hand, high officials of
the Kuomintang and the Government are leading a luxurious
existence. According to press reports, Madame Chiang Kai-
shek has made a huge fortune through the purchase of
aeroplanes, while Dr. H.H. Kung has misappropriated a
considerable sum of money through the construction of the
Yangtse Boom and his son Kung Ling-kan (孔令侃) has
made large profits through the purchasing of armaments.

(4) The Three Principles of the People are but
mere scraps of paper. They contain nothing of value from

(3) 自中日敌对行动爆发以来，民众被迫承受多次增加的负担，如航空税、救国税等。他们目前甚至无法维持生计。许多先前主张对日作战的人现在深感失望。但另一方面，国民党和政府的高官却过着奢侈的生活。据新闻报道，蒋介石夫人通过购买飞机发了大财，而孔祥熙博士则通过修建长江封锁线侵吞了巨额资金，其子孔令侃则通过军火采购牟取暴利。

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper)
published the following article on July 21 :-

DISPUTE AMONG FOREIGN OWNED CHINESE LANGUAGE NEWSPAPERS

The most popular foreign owned Chinese
language newspapers are the "Standard," the "Ta Mei Pao,"
the "Hwa Mei Chen Pao," the "News Digest," the "Morning
Leader" and the "Ta Ying Yeh Pao". At first the publishers
were engaged in developing their papers, but later they
formed themselves into two groups: the "Standard" for
the Kuomintang and the "News Digest," the "Morning Leader,"
etc. for the Communist Party. They criticise one another
and the dispute has taken on a more acute character.
For instance, the "Standard" once published an editorial
entitled "A Proposal" which drew a great deal of criticism
upon its head.
As a matter of fact, articles attacking
each other have also been published in Hankow by the
Chinese papers belonging to the Kuomintang, such as the
"Wuhan Jih Pao" and the "Sao Tang Pao," and the Communist
Party, such as the "Sin Hwa Jih Pao" and the "National
Salvation Daily News".

《新申报》（日资中文报纸）于7月21日刊登了以下文章：-

外资中文报纸之间的争端

最受欢迎的外资中文报纸有《标准报》（Standard）、《大美报》、《华美晨报》、《新闻文摘》（News Digest）、《晨导报》（Morning Leader）和《大英夜报》。起初，出版商致力于发展各自的报纸，但后来他们分成了两派：《标准报》支持国民党，而《新闻文摘》、《晨导报》等支持共产党。双方互相批评，争端日趋激烈。例如，《标准报》曾发表一篇题为《提议》的社论，招致大量批评。
事实上，属于国民党的中文报纸，如《武汉日报》和《扫荡报》，以及属于共产党的报纸，如《新华日报》和《救亡日报》，也在汉口发表了互相攻击的文章。

Pamphlets, extra-edition of the "Sin Shun Pao" Newspaper of a Pro-Japanese nature, distributed from M/Car, Lic. No.295 (S.D.F.).
D.S. Gigerson Chief Inspector.

Sir,

At 4.50.p.m. 19-5-38, S/I Tullock brought to Station
M/Car, Lic. No.295 of the Shanghai Defence Force, loaded with
pamphlets of a pro-Japanese nature and occupied by the following
persons:-
(1) Yonetaro Tanaka, age 30, Japanese.
(2) Taju Yamashita, age 30, Japanese.
(3) L.D. Xavier, age 25, Portuguese, 15 Garden Terrace,
112 Scott Road.
(4) Dzung Leh Pau (宗鼎培) age , Chinese, Chauffeur,
Permit No.19816, Japanese Army Headquarters, 93 Seward Road

J.D.S. Kobayashi attended and made enquiries, with C.D.S.
137 and the undersigned, when it was ascertained that the above
four persons are employed with the "Sin Shun Pao (新申报)"
Newspaper, 455 Chapoo Road, directed by Mr. Tamotsu Yamamoto and
owned by the Japanese Military Authorities.

The above M/Car was proceeding from East to West along
Nanking Road, and the occupants were distributing pamphlets,
by throwing them from the car.

The M/Car was first seen by S/I Tullock, who was on
Bicycle patrol, on Nanking Road near Kiangse Road. S/I Tullock
followed the M/Car and stopped same near Lloyd Road, requesting
the occupants to follow him to the Station.

Mr. Robertson, D.O."A" Division attended and explained
to the above named persons through J.D.S. Kobayashi that such
action of distributing pamphlets is likely to cause disturbance
in the International Settlement and gave instructions to J.D.S.
Kobayashi to accompany the above named with the pamphlets to
the Chapoo Road.

1938年5月19日下午4:50，巡佐 Tullock 将一辆上海防卫队所属、车牌号为295的汽车带到捕房，车上装载着具有亲日性质的小册子，车内人员如下：-
(1) Yonetaro Tanaka，30岁，日本人。
(2) Taju Yamashita，30岁，日本人。
(3) L.D. Xavier，25岁，葡萄牙人，住址：花园台15号，斯科特路112号。
(4) 宗鼎培（Dzung Leh Pau），年龄不详，中国人，司机，许可证号19816，日本陆军总部，西华德路93号

日本侦探股小林（Kobayashi）会同刑事侦探股137及本人进行了询问，查明上述四人均受雇于乍浦路455号的《新申报》报社，该报由山本保（Tamotsu Yamamoto）先生指导，归日本军方所有。

上述汽车沿南京路由东向西行驶，车内人员通过将小册子从车上抛下的方式进行分发。

该汽车首先由正在自行车巡逻的巡佐 Tullock 在南京路靠近江西路处发现。Tullock 巡佐跟随该汽车，并在靠近劳合路（Lloyd Road）处将其拦停，要求车内人员随他前往捕房。

“A”分区总监 Robertson 先生到场，并通过日本侦探股小林向上述人员解释，此类分发小册子的行为可能会在国际租界引起骚乱，并指示日本侦探股小林陪同上述人员携带小册子前往乍浦路。

谨报告，1938年5月19日下午4:45，当我伴随贝尔3号警员骑乘232号自行车沿南京路向东行驶时，观察到一辆悬挂204号牌照的大型黑色封闭汽车，车内有三名日本男子，由一名中国人驾驶，向西行驶。当该车行至南京路与爱文义路（Avenue Roads）交叉口时，其中一名日本乘客从上述汽车上抛下大量传单。我立即追赶，并在南京路与劳合路（Lloyd）拐角处拦停该车，将车及车内人员带至捕房。
在南京路爱文义路与劳合路之间，路面上散落着数把此类传单。
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
J. L. Tulloch.

The "Sin Shun Pao" (a Japanese owned Chinese language
newspaper) Extra Issue of May 19, 1938 :-

JAPANESE SOLDIERS TAKE HSUCHOW

According to a bulletin issued at noon on May 19
by the Japanese military in Shanghai, Japanese soldiers
attacking Hsuchow from Siao Hsien (蕭縣), Yungchen (永城)
and Jihshan (碭山) have broken the Chinese resistance and
are advancing. At 6 a.m. May 19, the Ogishima Detachment
seized Wunewshan (臥牛山) and entered the city of Hsuchow.
At 9.10 a.m. the Japanese soldiers occupied two sides of
Hsuchow and at 10 a.m. they had entered the centre of the city.
------------------
According to information from the front at Hsuchow,
General Tang En-pah, the senior commander of the Central Army,
is in a dilemma because he cannot check the attacks of the
Japanese forces in the eastern sector of Hsuchow. A few days
ago, General Tang asked General Sung Lien-chung to take over
the command of the Central Army and then fled to Kaifeng.
The whole Chinese line is now very shaky because of the steady
advance of the Japanese forces from different directions.
The Chinese are doing their best to rush out and withdraw,
but in the confusion, a clash occurred between soldiers of the
Central Armies and other Chinese units.
------------------
Just before noon on May 19, the Ogishima Detachment
attacking Hsuchow from the northern sector of the Lunghai
Line occupied Si Kwan (西關) and Tung Meng (東門), two most
important points for the defence of Hsuchow. When the Ogishima
Detachment attacked Pawanshan (霸王山) from the Lunghai Line,
the men of the 38th Division under General Chang Tsz-chung,
the 50th Division and the 96th Division of the Central Armies
put up a final resistance from the high land at Wunewshan and

《新申报》（一家日资中文报纸）1938年5月19日增刊：-

日军占领徐州

根据驻沪日军于5月19日中午发布的公报，从萧县、永城和砀山进攻徐州的日军已突破中国军队的抵抗并正在推进。5月19日上午6时，荻岛支队（Ogishima Detachment）攻占卧牛山并进入徐州市。上午9时10分，日军占领徐州两侧，上午10时已进入市中心。
------------------
根据徐州前线的消息，中央军高级指挥官汤恩伯将军陷入困境，因为他无法遏制日军对徐州东部的进攻。几天前，汤将军请求宋连仲（Sung Lien-chung，音译）将军接管中央军指挥权，随后逃往开封。由于日军从不同方向稳步推进，整个中国防线现在非常动摇。中国军队正尽力突围撤退，但在混乱中，中央军士兵与其他中国部队发生了冲突。
------------------
5月19日中午前不久，从陇海线北部进攻徐州的荻岛支队占领了西关和东门这两个徐州防御最重要的据点。当荻岛支队从陇海线进攻霸王山时，张自忠将军麾下的第38师、中央军第50师和第96师的士兵在卧牛山高地进行了最后抵抗，并

Siaoshants ( 小山子 ). The engagement continued throughout
the night and ended in the complete annihilation of the
Chinese troops. The Ogishima Detachment then gallantly
advanced into the city of Hsuchow.

On the morning of May 19, the Japanese artillery
units assisted the infantry by heavily bombarding the Chinese
positions from the western sector of Hsuchow. Meanwhile,
squadrons of Japanese aeroplanes bombed the Chinese positions
inside the city of Hsuchow, inflicting heavy casualties on
the retreating Chinese soldiers. Inside the city, severe
street fighting took place between the Japanese vanguards
and the Chinese soldiers, in which the Chinese sustained
heavy casualties.

5月19日上午，日军炮兵部队从徐州西部区域猛烈轰击中国军队阵地，以支援步兵作战。与此同时，日本飞机编队轰炸了徐州市内的中国军队阵地，给撤退中的中国士兵造成重大伤亡。在市内，日军先头部队与中国士兵之间发生了激烈的巷战，中国方面伤亡惨重。

Subject.........Pro-Japanese propaganda.

Made by....D.S.I. Shin Ssu-chien   Forwarded by...

（印：B / * 13 MAY 1938 / S...）

Attached to this report is a book of eighty three
pages entitled "The Construction of New China"(新中國之建設),
edited by one "Shen Sung" (申城 ) and purporting to have
emanated from the Continental Press. The contents of the
book deals chiefly with the construction work carried out by
the Japanese and the various "Self Control Bodies" in the
areas under Japanese control, and bitterly denounces the
Chiang Kai-shek regime. The following articles appear in the
book:-

1/. The importance of the declaration made by
Japanese Government.
2/. The Commander-in-chief (Chiang Kai-shek) should
be punished (for the defeats of Chinese Armies).
3/. The collapse of Kuomintang is very near.
4/. The economical reconstruction of New China.
5/. The bankruptcy of China which has its help from
Great Britain.
6/. The civilization of New China.
7/. The result of co-operation between Chiang Kai-shek
and the Communists.
8/. The collapse of the Popular Front of the French
Government.
9/. The Sino-Japanese rapprochement is what the
European and American people dread.

Enquiries show that the Continental Press is
situated at Room No.216, Hardoon Building, 223 Nanking Road,
at which address the Branch Office of the "Shanghai Godo"
is also located.

D.C.(Special Branch).

（批：Copy 8 / Book and / report to E. / 387 FILE / 3/5）

REPORT
File No. SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL P
S. B. REGIS
S. B. Dxxxx
Date April 5, 1938.

Subject Pro-Japanese Propaganda.

Made by Clerk Liao Chung Chien Forwarded by C Cxxxxx Dd.

Copies of a book entitled "The fall of Nanking and the Future of China" purporting to emanate from a "Dah Loh Zoe" Society (大陸社) (address not mentioned) are on sale at some of the newspaper stalls in the Settlement at 10 cents per copy. The book contains a number of essays drastically attacking the National Government for its "corrupt" administration and denouncing the Kuomintang for cooperating with the Communists in waging the war of resistance against Japan, whereby more than 700,000 Chinese officers and soldiers were killed and wounded and 100,000.000 people rendered homeless.

According to the stall-keepers, the literature was delivered to them by a certain Chinese who requested them to sell it on his behalf. Discreet enquiries were subsequently made and it has been ascertained that the Branch Office of the "Shanghai Godo," a Japanese daily, established at Room 216, Hardoon Building, 233 Nanking Road, is responsible for the distribution of the literature in question and that the Chinese, who approached the stall-keepers, is an employee of the daily. The "Shanghai Godo" publishes a Chinese edition, which is of a very strong anti-Chinese National Government nature.

Attached herewith is a copy of the book together with a translation of its preface.

(批：D Sub ?

dated 1/5/38)

5/4.)

C.P. Liao Chungchien.

to be sold ?
